stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 查阅患者病历并回答病例分析题。

title.en: Status epilepticus refractory to first-line benzodiazepine therapy
title.zh: 对一线苯二氮䓬类治疗无效的癫痫持续状态

summary.en:
A 27-year-old woman with a three-year history of generalized tonic-clonic epilepsy, managed with levetiracetam 1,000 mg PO twice daily, is brought to the emergency department by paramedics. She lives alone and was found seizing by a coworker who went to check on her after she failed to appear at work. The coworker reports the patient mentioned feeling "off" the previous evening. Paramedics document that generalized tonic-clonic seizure activity was observed on their arrival and that four minutes of continuous convulsive activity had already elapsed per the coworker's estimate. The patient's medication bottles were found at home; the levetiracetam bottle appeared mostly full despite a fill date three weeks ago, raising concern for medication nonadherence. She has no other significant medical history and no known allergies. A peripheral IV (20-gauge, right antecubital) was established in the field and lorazepam 4 mg IV was administered seven minutes into the seizure, followed by a second lorazepam 4 mg IV dose at twelve minutes due to ongoing seizure. She is now arriving at the ED, approximately fifteen minutes into continuous seizure activity.

On ED arrival the patient is on a stretcher in active generalized tonic-clonic seizure. She is unresponsive, with rhythmic bilateral upper- and lower-extremity tonic-clonic movements, jaw clenching, copious oral secretions, and urinary incontinence. There is no purposeful movement and no response to verbal stimuli. The seizure has not stopped despite two adequate doses of prehospital lorazepam. By definition — continuous convulsive seizure activity lasting longer than five minutes — this meets criteria for status epilepticus, and because the initial benzodiazepines have failed, it is now classified as established status epilepticus requiring urgent second-line therapy.
summary.zh:
一名27岁女性，有3年全身强直-阵挛性癫痫病史，长期口服左乙拉西坦1000 mg 每日两次，由急救人员送至急诊科。她独居，同事发现她未上班前去探望时发现她正在抽搐。同事反映患者前一天晚上曾提到感觉“不舒服”。急救人员记录他们到达时观察到全身强直-阵挛性癫痫发作，且据同事估计持续抽搐已达4分钟。患者的药瓶在家中被找到；尽管3周前刚开药，但左乙拉西坦药瓶看起来几乎是满的，提示可能存在用药依从性差。患者无其他重要病史及已知过敏史。现场在右侧肘前窝建立了20号外周静脉通路，并在癫痫发作7分钟时静脉注射了4 mg劳拉西泮，由于癫痫持续，在发作12分钟时又给予了第二剂4 mg劳拉西泮。她现在到达急诊科，持续癫痫发作约15分钟。

到达急诊科时，患者躺在平车上，处于活动性全身强直-阵挛性癫痫发作状态。患者无反应，双侧上下肢有节律地强直-阵挛性运动，牙关紧闭，口腔分泌物大量，大/小便失禁。无有目的的运动，对言语刺激无反应。尽管院前给予了两剂充足剂量的劳拉西泮，癫痫发作仍未停止。根据定义——持续惊厥性癫痫发作超过5分钟——这符合癫痫持续状态的标准，并且由于初始苯二氮䓬类药物失败，现在被归类为已确立的癫痫持续状态（established status epilepticus），需要紧急进行二线治疗。

title.zh: 基线评估及实验室数据

content.en:
Temperature 100.9 °F (38.3 °C) (tympanic), heart rate 138 bpm and regular on the monitor, blood pressure 178/102 mmHg, respiratory rate 28 (shallow and irregular, partially obscured by motor activity), SpO₂ 88% on room air. Pupils are equal at 4 mm but reactivity is difficult to assess during convulsive activity. Skin is diaphoretic and flushed. Bite injury to the lateral tongue with blood-tinged saliva. No signs of head trauma. The single peripheral IV is intact and running normal saline at a keep-vein-open rate. Continuous cardiac monitoring shows sinus tachycardia without ectopy. End-tidal CO₂ (if capnography is available) is 52 mmHg, consistent with hypoventilation. Fingerstick blood glucose is 142 mg/dL. A point-of-care urine pregnancy test is obtained and returns negative.

Laboratory results (drawn on arrival, returning over next 20-30 min):
Sodium 139 mEq/L, potassium 4.6 mEq/L, chloride 101 mEq/L, bicarbonate 16 mEq/L (low — lactic acidosis from prolonged muscle activity), BUN 14 mg/dL, creatinine 0.9 mg/dL, glucose 148 mg/dL, calcium (ionized) 1.14 mmol/L (normal), magnesium 1.8 mg/dL (normal), phosphorus 4.2 mg/dL, lactate 6.8 mmol/L (elevated), WBC 14.2 ×10³/µL (stress leukocytosis), hemoglobin 13.1 g/dL, platelets 224 ×10³/µL, CK 480 U/L (mildly elevated, expected to rise), levetiracetam serum level 4.2 µg/mL (subtherapeutic; reference range 12–46 µg/mL). Arterial blood gas: pH 7.24, PaCO₂ 48 mmHg, PaO₂ 68 mmHg, HCO₃ 16 mEq/L.
content.zh:
体温 100.9 °F (38.3 °C)（鼓膜），心率 138 次/分（监护仪显示规律），血压 178/102 mmHg，呼吸频率 28 次/分（浅慢且不规则，部分被运动活动掩盖），室内空气下 SpO₂ 88%。双侧瞳孔等大为 4 mm，但在惊厥活动期间对光反射难以评估。皮肤多汗且潮红。舌头侧面有咬伤伴有血丝唾液。无头部外伤迹象。单根外周静脉管路通畅，正在以保持静脉开放（KVO）速度滴注生理盐水。连续心电监护显示窦性心动过速，无异位心律。呼气末 CO₂（如果可以使用二氧化碳描记图的话）为 52 mmHg，符合通气不足。指尖血糖为 142 mg/dL。获取即时（POC）尿妊娠试验结果为阴性。

实验室结果（到达时抽血，在接下来的 20-30 分钟内返回）：
钠 139 mEq/L，钾 4.6 mEq/L，氯 101 mEq/L，碳酸氢盐 16 mEq/L（低 —— 长期肌肉活动导致的乳酸酸中毒），血尿素氮 (BUN) 14 mg/dL，肌酐 0.9 mg/dL，血糖 148 mg/dL，（离子）钙 1.14 mmol/L（正常），镁 1.8 mg/dL（正常），磷 4.2 mg/dL，乳酸 6.8 mmol/L（升高），白细胞 (WBC) 14.2 ×10³/µL（应激性白细胞增多），血红蛋白 13.1 g/dL，血小板 224 ×10³/µL，肌酸激酶 (CK) 480 U/L（轻度升高，预计会继续上升），左乙拉西坦血清水平 4.2 µg/mL（亚治疗水平；参考范围 12–46 µg/mL）。动脉血气 (ABG)：pH 7.24，PaCO₂ 48 mmHg，PaO₂ 68 mmHg，HCO₃ 16 mEq/L。

title.en: Stage 1 (0 to 8 minutes after ED arrival)
title.zh: 阶段 1（到达急诊科后 0 至 8 分钟）

content.en: 0 to 8 minutes after ED arrival (approximately 15–23 minutes of total seizure duration). The patient remains in continuous generalized tonic-clonic status epilepticus. The nurse positions her on her side, suctions oral secretions, applies supplemental oxygen via non-rebreather mask at 15 L/min, and ensures IV access. SpO₂ improves to 92%. The emergency physician orders fosphenytoin 20 mg phenytoin equivalents (PE)/kg IV at a maximum rate of 150 mg PE/min as second-line therapy. The nurse begins the infusion on an infusion pump through the existing 20-gauge PIV, with continuous cardiac monitoring and blood pressure checks every 5 minutes during infusion. Fingerstick glucose is rechecked and is 136 mg/dL. At the 6-minute mark of the fosphenytoin infusion, seizure activity has not ceased. Repeat vitals: T 101.5 °F (38.6 °C), HR 142, BP 172/98, RR 26, SpO₂ 93% on NRB. The patient remains unresponsive with ongoing tonic-clonic movements. No arrhythmia or hypotension noted during the infusion so far. A second peripheral IV (18-gauge, left forearm) is placed for additional access. Labs from the initial draw begin returning, confirming the subtherapeutic levetiracetam level and the metabolic acidosis.
content.zh: 到达急诊科后 0 至 8 分钟（癫痫发作总持续时间约 15-23 分钟）。患者仍处于持续的全身强直-阵挛性癫痫持续状态。护士将其置于侧卧位，吸出口腔分泌物，通过非重复呼吸面罩以 15 L/min 给予吸氧，并确保静脉通路畅通。SpO₂ 改善至 92%。急诊医生开具二线治疗方案：磷苯妥英 20 mg 苯妥英当量 (PE)/kg 静脉输注，最大输注速度为 150 mg PE/min。护士通过现有的 20 号外周静脉导管使用输液泵开始输注，并在输注期间进行持续心电监护和每 5 分钟一次的血压监测。复查指尖血糖为 136 mg/dL。在磷苯妥英输注到第 6 分钟时，癫痫发作活动尚未停止。复查生命体征：体温 101.5 °F (38.6 °C)，心率 142 次/分，血压 172/98 mmHg，呼吸 26 次/分，非重复呼吸面罩下 SpO₂ 93%。患者仍无反应，伴有持续的强直-阵挛性运动。到目前为止，输注期间未发现心律失常或低血压。建立第二根外周静脉通路（左前臂 18 号导管）以增加通道。初步抽血的化验结果开始返回，证实了左乙拉西坦处于亚治疗水平以及代谢性酸中毒。

title.en: Stage 2 (15 to 35 minutes after ED arrival)
title.zh: 阶段 2（到达急诊科后 15 至 35 分钟）

content.en: 15 to 35 minutes after ED arrival (approximately 30–50 minutes of total seizure duration). The fosphenytoin infusion is completed. Ten minutes after completion, motor seizure activity persists — this now meets criteria for refractory status epilepticus (failure of both first-line benzodiazepine and adequate second-line antiepileptic drug). The physician is notified. Updated vitals: T 102 °F (38.9 °C), HR 148, BP 164/96, RR 24 (still irregular), SpO₂ 91% on NRB (dropping despite supplemental O₂). End-tidal CO₂ 58 mmHg. The patient is developing increasing cyanosis around the lips, and secretions are copious despite ongoing suctioning, reflecting ongoing respiratory decline. The emergency physician calls for anesthesia/critical care for rapid sequence intubation and initiation of a continuous IV midazolam infusion for burst-suppression. The nurse prepares RSI medications (propofol, succinylcholine, and backup rocuronium) and equipment (endotracheal tube, laryngoscope/video laryngoscope, bag-valve mask, capnography). Repeat labs drawn at this point: lactate 9.4 mmol/L (rising), CK 1,220 U/L (rising significantly, raising concern for rhabdomyolysis), ABG pH 7.18, PaCO₂ 54 mmHg, PaO₂ 62 mmHg, bicarbonate 14 mEq/L. Potassium 5.1 mEq/L (rising from muscle breakdown). The patient is intubated successfully, placed on mechanical ventilation (FiO₂ 100%, tidal volume 6 mL/kg, PEEP 5 cm H₂O), and a continuous midazolam infusion is started at 0.2 mg/kg/hr per protocol after a 0.2 mg/kg IV bolus. An indwelling urinary catheter is placed; initial output is 40 mL of dark amber urine, which is sent for urinalysis and myoglobin. Continuous EEG monitoring is ordered and the electrodes are being placed. An arterial line is inserted in the right radial artery for continuous blood pressure monitoring and serial ABG sampling. Preparations are made for ICU transfer.
content.zh: 到达急诊科后 15 至 35 分钟（癫痫发作总持续时间约 30-50 分钟）。磷苯妥英输注完成。输注完成后 10 分钟，运动性癫痫发作活动仍在继续——这现在符合难治性癫痫持续状态（refractory status epilepticus）的标准（一线苯二氮䓬类药物和足量的二线抗癫痫药物均失败）。已通知医生。更新的生命体征：体温 102 °F (38.9 °C)，心率 148 次/分，血压 164/96 mmHg，呼吸 24 次/分（仍不规则），非重复呼吸面罩下 SpO₂ 91%（尽管有补充氧气，但仍在下降）。呼气末 CO₂ 为 58 mmHg。患者口唇周围的紫绀正在加重，尽管不断吸引，分泌物仍然很多，反映了呼吸功能正在持续衰退。急诊医生呼叫麻醉科/重症医学科，准备进行快速诱导气管插管（RSI）并开始静脉持续输注咪达唑仑以达到爆发抑制（burst-suppression）。护士准备 RSI 药物（丙泊酚、琥珀胆碱和备用的罗库溴铵）和设备（气管导管、喉镜/可视喉镜、球囊面罩、二氧化碳描记图）。此时重新抽血化验：乳酸 9.4 mmol/L（上升中），CK 1,220 U/L（显著上升，引起对横纹肌溶解的担忧），ABG：pH 7.18，PaCO₂ 54 mmHg，PaO₂ 62 mmHg，碳酸氢盐 14 mEq/L。钾 5.1 mEq/L（因肌肉分解而升高）。患者被成功插管，连接机械通气（FiO₂ 100%，潮气量 6 mL/kg，PEEP 5 cm H₂O），并在静脉推注 0.2 mg/kg 咪达唑仑后，根据方案开始以 0.2 mg/kg/hr 的速度持续输注。留置导尿管；初始尿量为 40 mL 深琥珀色尿液，被送去进行尿液分析和肌红蛋白检测。已医嘱开具连续脑电图监测，并且电极正在放置中。在右桡动脉内置入动脉导管，用于连续血压监测和连续动脉血气采样。正在为转入 ICU 做准备。

title.en: Stage 3 (35 to 70 minutes after ED arrival)
title.zh: 阶段 3（到达急诊科后 35 至 70 分钟）

content.en: 35 to 70 minutes after ED arrival (approximately 50–85 minutes of total seizure duration and into the first ICU hour). After 10 minutes of the midazolam infusion, visible motor seizure activity ceases. However, continuous EEG reveals ongoing electrographic seizure activity (rhythmic spike-and-wave discharges) for an additional 8 minutes before the midazolam infusion rate is titrated upward to 0.3 mg/kg/hr and electrographic seizures finally terminate. The patient is now in a pharmacologically induced state of burst-suppression on EEG, which is the ordered ICU protocol target for this case. Post-intubation vitals begin to stabilize: T 101.1 °F (38.4 °C) (trending down with cooling measures), HR 112, BP 128/78 (now on vasopressor-free arterial-line monitoring), RR set at 16 on the ventilator, SpO₂ 99% on FiO₂ 60%. Urine output over the first ICU hour is 120 mL, which is below the target of 1–3 mL/kg/hr; the urine is tea-colored and urine myoglobin returns markedly positive. The nurse reports this, and IV isotonic fluids are titrated up toward 300 mL/hr per protocol/order for rhabdomyolysis management. Repeat labs at the one-hour ICU mark: lactate 5.2 mmol/L (falling), CK 2,800 U/L (still rising but expected to peak and then fall), potassium 5.3 mEq/L (stable, being monitored closely), creatinine 1.1 mg/dL (slight rise), ABG pH 7.30, PaCO₂ 38 mmHg (improved with mechanical ventilation), PaO₂ 142 mmHg (on FiO₂ 60%), bicarbonate 18 mEq/L (improving). The nurse maintains continuous EEG monitoring and reports any return of electrographic seizure patterns to the provider, keeps the head of bed elevated at 30 degrees, monitors the midazolam infusion, performs neurological assessments (pupil reactivity, response to stimuli) at least hourly, monitors urine output and color for rhabdomyolysis resolution, and maintains seizure precautions including padded side rails and suction at bedside.
content.zh: 到达急诊科后 35 至 70 分钟（癫痫发作总持续时间约 50-85 分钟，并进入 ICU 的第一个小时）。在咪达唑仑输注 10 分钟后，可见的运动性癫痫发作活动停止。然而，连续脑电图显示持续的脑电癫痫活动（节律性棘慢波放电）又维持了 8 分钟，之后将咪达唑仑输注速度上调至 0.3 mg/kg/hr，脑电癫痫发作最终终止。患者目前在脑电图上处于药物诱导的爆发抑制（burst-suppression）状态，这是本病例医嘱的 ICU 方案目标。插管后的生命体征开始稳定：体温 101.1 °F (38.4 °C)（采取降温措施后呈下降趋势），心率 112 次/分，血压 128/78 mmHg（目前在无血管加压药的情况下进行动脉导管监测），呼吸机设定频率 16 次/分，FiO₂ 60% 下 SpO₂ 99%。ICU 第一个小时内的尿量为 120 mL，低于 1-3 mL/kg/hr 的目标；尿液呈茶色，尿肌红蛋白结果呈显著阳性。护士报告了这一情况，静脉等渗液体被滴定至接近 300 mL/hr（根据方案/医嘱），以处理横纹肌溶解。在进入 ICU 一小时时的复查化验：乳酸 5.2 mmol/L（下降），CK 2,800 U/L（仍在上升，但预计将达到峰值后下降），钾 5.3 mEq/L（稳定，正在密切监测中），肌酐 1.1 mg/dL（轻微上升），ABG：pH 7.30，PaCO₂ 38 mmHg（通过机械通气改善），PaO₂ 142 mmHg（在 FiO₂ 60% 下），碳酸氢盐 18 mEq/L（改善中）。护士保持连续脑电图监测，向医生报告任何脑电图癫痫模式的恢复，保持床头抬高 30 度，监测咪达唑仑的输注，至少每小时进行一次神经系统评估（瞳孔反应性、对刺激的反应），监测尿量和颜色以观察横纹肌溶解的消退情况，并维持癫痫发作预防措施，包括使用带衬垫的床栏和床边备好吸引器。

stem.en: The nurse receives the patient on ED arrival. Which of the following is the most appropriate interpretation of the patient's current status based on the prehospital report?
stem.zh: 护士在患者到达急诊科时接收患者。根据院前报告，以下哪项是对患者当前状态最恰当的解读？

options.en: The patient requires a third dose of intravenous lorazepam in the ED before progressing to second-line agents.
options.zh: 患者在急诊科需要注射第三剂静脉劳拉西泮，然后再进展到使用二线药物。

options.en: The patient is experiencing an expected postictal phase after prehospital treatment.
options.zh: 患者在接受院前治疗后正经历预期的发作后状态。

options.en: The patient's continuous seizure activity is likely due to prehospital medication administration errors.
options.zh: 患者持续的癫痫发作活动很可能是由于院前给药错误导致的。

options.en: The patient is in established status epilepticus because two adequate doses of first-line therapy have failed.
options.zh: 患者处于已确立的癫痫持续状态，因为两剂充足剂量的一线治疗已经失败。

correct.en: Status epilepticus is defined as continuous seizure activity lasting more than five minutes or two or more seizures without return to baseline consciousness. Once adequate benzodiazepine doses have failed, the Neurocritical Care Society and AES guidelines direct immediate administration of a second-line agent. Delay increases morbidity, mortality, and the likelihood of pharmacoresistance. Recognizing the failure of first-line therapy is the critical nursing cue that drives the urgency of escalation.
correct.zh: 癫痫持续状态定义为持续惊厥发作超过 5 分钟或两次及以上发作之间未恢复基线意识。一旦足量的苯二氮䓬类药物失败，神经重症监护学会和 AES 指南指导立即给予二线药物。延迟会增加发病率、死亡率和产生耐药性的可能性。认识到一线治疗失败是推动紧急升级的至关重要的护理线索。

byChoice.en: The patient is in active tonic-clonic seizure, not a postictal phase. The postictal phase occurs after seizure termination and is characterized by confusion and lethargy, not rhythmic convulsive movements.
byChoice.zh: 患者处于活动性的强直-阵挛性癫痫发作，而不是发作后阶段。发作后阶段发生在癫痫终止后，其特征是意识模糊和嗜睡，而不是有节律的惊厥运动。

byChoice.en: Administering a third dose of lorazepam IV in the ED instead of moving to a second-line agent is a critical error. While a repeat benzodiazepine dose is often protocolized when the first dose fails, in this case two adequate IV doses were already given and failed. Repeatedly administering failed interventions wastes critical time and increases the risk of respiratory depression without effectively terminating the seizure.
byChoice.zh: 在急诊科注射第三剂静脉劳拉西泮而不是转向二线药物是一个严重的错误。虽然当首剂失败时，重复给予苯二氮䓬类药物常常在方案中被规定，但在本病例中，已经给予了两剂足量的静脉注射药物均告失败。重复实施无效的干预措施会浪费关键时间，并增加呼吸抑制的风险，而不能有效地终止癫痫发作。

byChoice.en: There is no evidence of prehospital medication error. The paramedics correctly established an IV and administered appropriate doses of lorazepam according to standard protocols.
byChoice.zh: 没有证据表明存在院前用药错误。急救人员按照标准方案正确地建立了静脉通路并给予了合适剂量的劳拉西泮。

byChoice.en: The patient has had continuous convulsive activity for approximately fifteen minutes and has already received two 4 mg IV doses of lorazepam without cessation of the seizure. This meets the criteria for established status epilepticus that requires immediate escalation to a second-line antiepileptic drug.
byChoice.zh: 患者持续惊厥活动约十五分钟，并且已经接受了两次 4 mg 剂量的静脉注射劳拉西泮，但癫痫发作并未停止。这符合已确立的癫痫持续状态的标准，需要立即升级为二线抗癫痫药物。

testTakingStrategy.en: Evaluate the clinical criteria for status epilepticus and recognize when escalation of care is indicated based on the failure of initial interventions.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 评估癫痫持续状态的临床标准，并根据初始干预措施的失败认识到何时有必要进行治疗升级。

glossary.defZh: 一次癫痫发作持续超过5分钟，或发作间期意识未完全恢复又频繁复发的一系列发作。
癫痫发作后的一段意识模糊和恢复期。

stem.en: Review the baseline assessment and laboratory data. For each finding, determine if it indicates a primary cause of the status epilepticus or a secondary consequence of the prolonged seizure.
stem.zh: 回顾基线评估和实验室数据。对于以下各项发现，请确定它是指示癫痫持续状态的主要原因，还是长时间癫痫发作的继发后果。

rows.zh: 亚治疗水平的左乙拉西坦

columns.zh: 可能的诱发因素 / 主要促成因素

correct.en: Medication nonadherence is a common major contributor to status epilepticus in patients with known epilepsy, and the subtherapeutic levetiracetam level strongly supports this. Identifying this helps the team target therapy while continuing evaluation for other precipitants after stabilization. Lactate elevation and metabolic acidosis (low bicarbonate) are expected consequences of sustained seizure-related muscle activity and do not independently require sodium bicarbonate infusion — they resolve when seizures stop. Early CK elevation is a secondary consequence that flags the need for aggressive IV hydration to prevent myoglobin-induced acute kidney injury.
correct.zh: 用药依从性差是已知癫痫患者发生癫痫持续状态的常见主要促成因素，亚治疗水平的左乙拉西坦强烈支持这一点。识别出这一点有助于医疗团队进行靶向治疗，同时在患者稳定后继续评估其他诱因。乳酸升高和代谢性酸中毒（低碳酸氢盐）是持续性癫痫相关肌肉活动带来的预期后果，不需要独立地输注碳酸氢钠——当癫痫发作停止时它们就会消退。早期的 CK 升高是一种继发性后果，提示需要进行积极的静脉补液，以防止肌红蛋白诱发的急性肾损伤。

byChoice.en: The subtherapeutic levetiracetam level strongly supports medication nonadherence as a major contributing factor (primary cause) to the status epilepticus.
byChoice.zh: 亚治疗水平的左乙拉西坦强烈支持用药依从性差作为癫痫持续状态的主要促发因素（主要原因）。

byChoice.en: Elevated lactate reflects lactic acidosis from prolonged skeletal muscle hyperactivity and is a secondary consequence.
byChoice.zh: 乳酸升高反映了长时间骨骼肌过度活动引起的乳酸酸中毒，是继发后果。

byChoice.en: A low bicarbonate level (16 mEq/L) represents the metabolic acidosis that occurs secondary to the elevated lactic acid production during continuous muscle contraction.
byChoice.zh: 低碳酸氢盐水平（16 mEq/L）代表了由于持续肌肉收缩期间乳酸产生升高而继发出现的代谢性酸中毒。

byChoice.en: The elevated CK indicates early muscle breakdown (rhabdomyolysis) as a direct secondary consequence of the sustained tonic-clonic activity.
byChoice.zh: 升高的 CK 表明持续的强直-阵挛活动直接导致了早期的肌肉分解（横纹肌溶解），这是继发后果。

testTakingStrategy.en: Differentiate between the underlying triggers of a condition and the physiological derangements resulting from the condition itself.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 区分疾病的潜在诱因与由该疾病本身造成的生理机能紊乱。

glossary.defZh: 导致特定状况或事件发生的因素。
由于乳酸在体内积聚导致的代谢性酸中毒。

stem.en: Review the Clinical Course for Stage 1. The nurse is administering the prescribed fosphenytoin IV. Which of the following are priority nursing interventions during this infusion? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 查看阶段 1 的临床病程。护士正在执行医嘱静脉输注磷苯妥英。在输注期间，以下哪些是优先的护理干预措施？请选择所有适用项。

options.en: Administer the infusion as an IV push over 1-2 minutes.
options.zh: 在 1-2 分钟内静脉推注该药液。

options.en: Monitor blood pressure every 5 minutes.
options.zh: 每 5 分钟监测一次血压。

options.en: Observe for cessation of seizure activity.
options.zh: 观察癫痫发作活动是否停止。

options.en: Maintain continuous cardiac monitoring.
options.zh: 保持连续心电监护。

options.en: Ensure the infusion rate does not exceed 150 mg PE/min.
options.zh: 确保输注速度不超过 150 mg PE/min。

correct.en: The nurse must monitor for cardiac arrhythmias (continuous telemetry), hypotension (blood pressure every 5 minutes during infusion), and observe for seizure cessation as the therapeutic endpoint. Fosphenytoin can cause QT prolongation, bradycardia, and hypotension through its effect on cardiac sodium channels, particularly at rapid infusion rates. Cardiovascular collapse is a known fatal complication of too-rapid administration. The infusion rate must not exceed 150 mg PE/min.
correct.zh: 护士必须监测心律失常（连续心电监护）、低血压（输注期间每 5 分钟测一次血压），并观察癫痫发作是否停止作为治疗终点。磷苯妥英通过对心脏钠通道的作用，可能导致 QT 间期延长、心动过缓和低血压，特别是在快速输注时。心血管虚脱是已知的一种因给药过快导致的致命并发症。输注速度不得超过 150 mg PE/min。

byChoice.en: Continuous cardiac monitoring is required because fosphenytoin can cause severe arrhythmias, particularly if infused too rapidly.
byChoice.zh: 需要持续心电监护，因为磷苯妥英可能引起严重的心律失常，特别是如果输注过快的话。

byChoice.en: Fosphenytoin should never be administered as a rapid IV push. Exceeding the maximum infusion rate risks severe hypotension, cardiac arrhythmias, and cardiovascular collapse.
byChoice.zh: 绝对不能以快速静脉推注的方式给予磷苯妥英。超过最大输注速度会带来严重低血压、心律失常和心血管虚脱的风险。

byChoice.en: Hypotension is a significant adverse effect of fosphenytoin; frequent blood pressure monitoring (e.g., every 5 minutes) is essential during the infusion.
byChoice.zh: 低血压是磷苯妥英的显著不良反应；在输注期间进行频繁的血压监测（例如，每 5 分钟一次）是必不可少的。

byChoice.en: The maximum safe infusion rate for fosphenytoin is 150 mg PE (phenytoin equivalents) per minute to prevent life-threatening cardiovascular effects.
byChoice.zh: 磷苯妥英的最大安全输注速度为 150 mg PE（苯妥英当量）每分钟，以防止危及生命的心血管副作用。

byChoice.en: The therapeutic endpoint is seizure termination. The nurse must track whether the drug is achieving its goal to inform the provider if it fails, which drives the next escalation step.
byChoice.zh: 治疗的终点是癫痫发作终止。护士必须追踪该药物是否达到了目标，以便在失败时通知医生，这推动了下一步的升级治疗。

testTakingStrategy.en: Identify safety parameters for high-alert antiepileptic medications, specifically cardiovascular monitoring requirements and maximum infusion rates.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 识别高危抗癫痫药物的安全参数，特别是心血管监测要求和最大输注速度。

glossary.defZh: 一种抗惊厥药物，为苯妥英的前体药物，常用于治疗癫痫持续状态。
磷苯妥英剂量的计量单位，表明其转化为苯妥英的数量。

stem.en: Review the Clinical Course for Stage 2. The nurse observes that motor seizure activity persists, SpO₂ is 91%, end-tidal CO₂ is 58 mmHg, and the patient has copious secretions with increasing cyanosis. Which of the following problems should the nurse prioritize at this time?
stem.zh: 查看阶段 2 的临床病程。护士观察到运动性癫痫发作活动仍在持续，SpO₂ 为 91%，呼气末 CO₂ 为 58 mmHg，并且患者有大量分泌物伴有逐渐加重的发绀。此时护士应优先解决以下哪个问题？

options.en: Refractory seizure activity requiring additional antiepileptics
options.zh: 难治性癫痫发作活动，需要额外的抗癫痫药物

options.en: Developing rhabdomyolysis
options.zh: 发展中的横纹肌溶解

options.en: Compromised airway and impending respiratory failure
options.zh: 气道受损和即将发生的呼吸衰竭

options.en: Worsening metabolic acidosis
options.zh: 恶化的代谢性酸中毒

correct.en: Even though terminating the seizure is the ultimate goal, the patient cannot survive the seizure if she cannot oxygenate and ventilate. The falling SpO₂, rising CO₂, and copious secretions signal impending respiratory failure. Applying the ABCs framework, airway protection through intubation takes precedence. Furthermore, the continuous infusion agents used for refractory status epilepticus (midazolam, propofol) cause respiratory depression and require a secured airway before they can be safely administered. Therefore, intubation both protects the patient's breathing and enables definitive seizure treatment.
correct.zh: 尽管终止癫痫发作是最终目标，但如果患者不能进行氧合和通气，她将无法在癫痫发作中存活下来。SpO₂ 下降、CO₂ 升高以及大量分泌物标志着呼吸衰竭即将来临。应用 ABCs 框架，通过气管插管保护气道具有优先权。此外，用于难治性癫痫持续状态的持续输注药物（咪达唑仑、丙泊酚）会导致呼吸抑制，并且需要确保气道安全才能安全给药。因此，气管插管既保护了患者的呼吸，也使决定性的抗癫痫治疗成为可能。

byChoice.en: Rhabdomyolysis (indicated by rising CK) is a serious complication that requires intervention, but it will not cause immediate death. Applying the ABCs prioritization framework, airway failure poses a more immediate threat to life.
byChoice.zh: 横纹肌溶解（CK 升高表明）是需要干预的严重并发症，但不会立即导致死亡。应用 ABCs 优先级框架，气道衰竭对生命的直接威胁更大。

byChoice.en: Although the refractory seizures need to be stopped, administering powerful continuous infusions like midazolam or propofol without first securing the airway will precipitate respiratory arrest. Airway management must come first.
byChoice.zh: 虽然需要停止难治性癫痫发作，但在没有先固定气道的情况下给予像咪达唑仑或丙泊酚这样强效的连续输注药物会引发呼吸骤停。气道管理必须放在首位。

byChoice.en: The clinical cues (dropping SpO₂, high ETCO₂, cyanosis, copious secretions) clearly indicate respiratory failure. Securing the airway (via intubation) is the highest priority and must precede the initiation of suppressive anesthetic drips.
byChoice.zh: 这些临床线索（SpO₂ 下降，ETCO₂ 升高，紫绀，大量分泌物）清楚地表明呼吸衰竭。确保气道畅通（通过插管）是最高优先级，并且必须在开始滴注抑制性麻醉药物之前进行。

byChoice.en: While the metabolic acidosis is worsening (pH 7.18), it is secondary to the seizure and hypoxia. Airway management takes priority over correcting the metabolic derangement.
byChoice.zh: 虽然代谢性酸中毒正在恶化（pH 7.18），但它是继发于癫痫发作和缺氧的。气道管理优先于纠正代谢紊乱。

testTakingStrategy.en: Apply the Airway, Breathing, Circulation (ABC) prioritization framework. When a patient has an acute airway issue, it takes precedence over secondary complications or definitive treatments that require a secure airway.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 应用气道、呼吸、循环（ABC）优先级框架。当患者出现急性气道问题时，它优先于继发性并发症或需要确保气道安全才能进行的决定性治疗。

glossary.defZh: 呼吸系统无法充分维持氧气和二氧化碳交换，且即将发生失代偿的状态。
对适当剂量的一线和二线抗癫痫药物均无效的癫痫持续状态。

stem.en: Review the Clinical Course for Stage 3. Visible motor seizure activity has ceased 10 minutes after starting the midazolam infusion.
stem.zh: 查看阶段 3 的临床病程。在开始咪达唑仑输注 10 分钟后，可见的运动性癫痫发作活动已经停止。

clozeStem.en: The nurse should interpret that the seizure {{1}} because {{2}}.
clozeStem.zh: 护士应该理解，该癫痫发作 {{1}}，因为 {{2}}。

options.en: will resume within 5 minutes
options.zh: 将在 5 分钟内恢复

options.en: has been fully terminated
options.zh: 已被完全终止

options.en: may be continuing electrographically
options.zh: 可能仍在脑电水平上继续

options.en: cessation of visible motor activity does not equal seizure termination
options.zh: 可见运动活动的停止并不等于癫痫发作终止

options.en: the midazolam dose is too low to produce any effect
options.zh: 咪达唑仑剂量太低以至于无法产生任何效果

options.en: the patient is paralyzed from the succinylcholine alone
options.zh: 患者仅仅因为琥珀胆碱而处于瘫痪状态

correct.en: In status epilepticus, especially after prolonged seizure activity and the administration of neuromuscular blocking agents during RSI (succinylcholine), motor manifestations may cease while cortical seizure activity continues — this is called nonconvulsive status epilepticus. Ongoing electrographic seizure activity causes continued neuronal injury. Continuous EEG is the gold standard for confirming seizure termination. In this case, the ordered therapeutic target for the continuous midazolam infusion is burst-suppression on EEG.
correct.zh: 在癫痫持续状态中，特别是在长时间的癫痫发作活动以及在 RSI 期间给予神经肌肉阻滞剂（琥珀胆碱）之后，运动表现可能会停止，而皮层癫痫发作活动仍在继续——这被称为非惊厥性癫痫持续状态。持续的脑电癫痫发作活动会导致持续的神经元损伤。连续脑电图是确认癫痫发作终止的黄金标准。在这个病例中，持续输注咪达唑仑的医嘱治疗目标是达到脑电图上的爆发抑制。

byChoice.en: The seizure may be continuing electrographically (nonconvulsive status epilepticus). The nurse must not assume the seizure has fully terminated simply because motor movements have stopped. Continuous EEG is required to evaluate the outcome.
byChoice.zh: 癫痫发作可能仍在脑电水平上继续（非惊厥性癫痫持续状态）。护士绝不能仅仅因为运动已经停止就想当然地认为癫痫发作已完全终止。需要连续脑电图来评估结果。

byChoice.en: Cessation of visible motor activity does not equal seizure termination. Stopping or reducing the midazolam infusion based on motor cessation alone is a dangerous error that can allow neuronal injury to continue undetected.
byChoice.zh: 可见运动活动的停止并不等于癫痫发作的终止。仅仅根据运动停止就停止或减少咪达唑仑的输注是一个危险的错误，这会让神经元损伤在未被察觉的情况下继续发生。

testTakingStrategy.en: Remember that neuromuscular blockade and prolonged exhaustion can mask the outward physical signs of a seizure. Cortical electrical activity must be evaluated.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 记住，神经肌肉阻滞和长时间的衰竭可能会掩盖癫痫发作的外部身体体征。必须对皮层电活动进行评估。

glossary.defZh: 仅通过脑电图(EEG)发现的异常大脑电活动，没有明显的临床症状。
脑电图上的一种模式，特征为高电压电活动期与电静息期交替出现，常为深度麻醉或脑损伤的标志。

stem.en: Review the Clinical Course for Stage 3. The patient's urine output over the first ICU hour is 120 mL, and the urine myoglobin is markedly positive. Which of the following nursing actions is most appropriate?
stem.zh: 查看阶段 3 的临床病程。患者在 ICU 第一个小时的尿量为 120 mL，且尿肌红蛋白呈显著阳性。以下哪项护理干预措施最合适？

options.en: Decrease the IV fluid rate to 50 mL/hr to prevent fluid volume overload during mechanical ventilation.
options.zh: 将静脉输液速度降低至 50 mL/hr，以防止机械通气期间的容量超负荷。

options.en: Titrate IV isotonic fluids up toward 300 mL/hr as ordered to manage rhabdomyolysis.
options.zh: 按医嘱将静脉等渗液体滴定至接近 300 mL/hr，以处理横纹肌溶解。

options.en: Remove the indwelling urinary catheter to reduce the risk of catheter-associated infection.
options.zh: 拔除留置导尿管以降低导管相关感染的风险。

options.en: Administer an IV fluid bolus of dextrose 5% in water to correct metabolic acidosis.
options.zh: 静脉推注 5% 葡萄糖水溶液以纠正代谢性酸中毒。

correct.en: Sustained tonic-clonic muscle activity causes massive skeletal muscle breakdown, releasing myoglobin into the bloodstream. Myoglobin is freely filtered by the glomerulus and precipitates in renal tubules, causing acute kidney injury. The combination of rising CK, dark urine, and positive urine myoglobin confirms rhabdomyolysis. Early aggressive crystalloid hydration (e.g., isotonic fluids titrated to maintain high urine output per protocol, often 1-3 mL/kg/hr or up to 300 mL/hr) is the cornerstone of prevention of renal failure.
correct.zh: 持续的强直-阵挛肌肉活动会导致骨骼肌大量分解，将肌红蛋白释放到血流中。肌红蛋白可自由滤过肾小球并沉淀在肾小管中，引起急性肾损伤。CK 的上升、深色尿液和尿肌红蛋白阳性证实了横纹肌溶解的存在。早期积极的晶体液补液（例如，根据方案将等渗液体滴定以维持高尿量，通常为 1-3 mL/kg/hr 或高达 300 mL/hr）是预防肾衰竭的基石。

byChoice.en: Decreasing the fluid rate is contraindicated. Failing to monitor urine output and color, and failing to aggressively hydrate, allows rhabdomyolysis to progress to acute kidney injury.
byChoice.zh: 降低输液速度是禁忌的。如果不监测尿量和颜色，并且不进行积极的补液，就会导致横纹肌溶解进展为急性肾损伤。

byChoice.en: Increasing isotonic IV fluids to achieve high urine output targets (e.g., up to 300 mL/hr) flushes myoglobin through the kidneys and helps prevent acute tubular necrosis.
byChoice.zh: 增加等渗静脉输液以达到高尿量目标（例如，高达 300 mL/hr）可以冲洗肾脏中的肌红蛋白，有助于预防急性肾小管坏死。

byChoice.en: Dextrose 5% in water (D5W) is hypotonic and does not provide adequate intravascular volume expansion. Isotonic fluids (like normal saline) are required for the aggressive hydration needed in rhabdomyolysis.
byChoice.zh: 5% 葡萄糖水溶液 (D5W) 是低渗的，不能提供足够的血管内容量扩张。横纹肌溶解所需的积极补液必须使用等渗液体（如生理盐水）。

byChoice.en: The indwelling catheter is essential for hourly monitoring of urine output and response to fluid resuscitation in a patient with rhabdomyolysis.
byChoice.zh: 留置导尿管对于横纹肌溶解患者进行每小时尿量监测和补液反应监测是必不可少的。

testTakingStrategy.en: Recognize the classic triad of rhabdomyolysis (elevated CK, dark urine, positive myoglobin) and associate it with the immediate need for aggressive IV fluid resuscitation to protect the kidneys.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 识别横纹肌溶解的典型三联征（CK升高、深色尿液、肌红蛋白阳性），并将其与为了保护肾脏而立即需要积极的静脉补液复苏联系起来。

glossary.defZh: 骨骼肌组织的破坏，导致肌肉纤维内容物（肌红蛋白）释放入血，可能引起肾损害。
存在于肌肉细胞中的一种携氧蛋白，当大量释放入血时可能阻塞肾小管并导致肾衰竭。

correct.en: This case emphasizes the prompt recognition and escalation of care in status epilepticus. First-line failure dictates immediate administration of a second-line antiepileptic like fosphenytoin while monitoring cardiovascular status. As the patient progresses to refractory status epilepticus, respiratory decline necessitates prioritizing definitive airway protection (intubation) before initiating continuous midazolam infusions. Continuous EEG is paramount for confirming the cessation of electrographic seizures (targeting burst-suppression), even after motor movements stop. Finally, identifying and treating secondary complications, such as rhabdomyolysis with aggressive fluid hydration, is crucial for preventing acute kidney injury.
correct.zh: 该病例强调了在癫痫持续状态中及时识别和升级治疗的重要性。一线治疗失败要求立即使用诸如磷苯妥英等二线抗癫痫药物，同时监测心血管状态。当患者进展为难治性癫痫持续状态时，呼吸衰退要求在开始持续输注咪达唑仑之前，优先进行确定性的气道保护（气管插管）。即使在运动性动作停止之后，连续脑电图对于确认脑电癫痫发作的停止（目标为爆发抑制）也是至关重要的。最后，识别并治疗继发性并发症，如通过积极的补液治疗横纹肌溶解，对于预防急性肾损伤至关重要。

testTakingStrategy.en: Approach status epilepticus systematically: ensure ABCs (airway priority if impending failure), adhere strictly to medication guidelines (recognizing failure of prior doses), rely on objective data (EEG) over physical observation alone, and proactively manage predictable complications like rhabdomyolysis.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 系统性地处理癫痫持续状态：确保气道、呼吸和循环（ABCs，如果即将发生衰竭则气道优先），严格遵守用药指南（识别先前剂量的失败），依赖客观数据（脑电图）而不仅仅是身体观察，并主动处理可预测的并发症，如横纹肌溶解。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the medication-reconciliation case-study items.
stem.zh: 阅读患者记录，并回答用药核对案例题。

title.en: Unfolding case: discharge medication reconciliation after total knee arthroplasty
title.zh: 展开案例：全膝关节置换术后出院用药核对

summary.en: A 71-year-old client with atrial fibrillation and chronic kidney disease is preparing for discharge after left total knee arthroplasty. The nurse compares the admission home medication list, inpatient MAR, and discharge prescription list and identifies possible medication discrepancies before prescriptions are sent.
summary.zh: 一名71岁患者有心房颤动和慢性肾病，左全膝关节置换术后准备出院。护士在处方发送前，将入院家庭用药清单、住院给药记录和出院处方清单进行比较，发现可能的用药差异。

content.en:
History: permanent atrial fibrillation, hypertension, type 2 diabetes mellitus, chronic kidney disease stage 3a, osteoarthritis. Left total knee arthroplasty was performed 4 days ago.
Home medications documented at admission: warfarin 5 mg daily, lisinopril 20 mg daily, metformin 500 mg twice daily, amlodipine 5 mg daily, acetaminophen 650 mg as needed.
Inpatient course: warfarin held perioperatively; enoxaparin 1 mg/kg subcutaneously every 12 hours used while warfarin was held/restarted. Warfarin restarted on postoperative day 2.
Assessment: alert and oriented; daughter present as caregiver. T 36.8 C, HR 78 irregularly irregular, BP 134/76, RR 16, SpO2 97% on room air. Left knee incision clean, dry, intact; mild ecchymosis and expected postoperative edema. No gum bleeding, petechiae, melena, or hematuria reported.
Laboratory results: INR 1.8, PT 21.4 seconds, aPTT 34 seconds, hemoglobin 10.8 g/dL and stable from postoperative day 1, platelets 198 ×10³/µL, creatinine 1.7 mg/dL, eGFR 44 mL/min, BUN 28 mg/dL, potassium 4.6 mEq/L, fasting glucose 142 mg/dL.
content.zh:
病史：永久性心房颤动、高血压、2型糖尿病、3a期慢性肾病、骨关节炎。4天前行左全膝关节置换术。
入院时记录的家庭用药：华法林5 mg每日一次、赖诺普利20 mg每日一次、二甲双胍500 mg每日两次、氨氯地平5 mg每日一次、对乙酰氨基酚650 mg必要时使用。
住院经过：围手术期暂停华法林；在华法林暂停/重新开始期间使用依诺肝素1 mg/kg皮下注射每12小时一次。术后第2天重新开始华法林。
评估：清醒，定向力正常；女儿在场并将担任照护者。体温98.2 °F (36.8 °C)，心率78次/分且节律绝对不齐，血压134/76 mmHg，呼吸16次/分，室内空气SpO2 97%。左膝切口清洁、干燥、完整；轻度瘀斑和符合术后情况的水肿。未报告牙龈出血、瘀点、黑便或血尿。
实验室结果：INR 1.8，PT 21.4秒，aPTT 34秒，血红蛋白10.8 g/dL且较术后第1天稳定，血小板198 ×10³/µL，肌酐1.7 mg/dL，eGFR 44 mL/min，BUN 28 mg/dL，钾4.6 mEq/L，空腹血糖142 mg/dL。

content.en:
The printed discharge prescription list generated by the covering resident includes: warfarin 5 mg daily; enoxaparin 40 mg subcutaneously daily for 14 days, listed as post-TKA VTE prophylaxis; lisinopril 20 mg daily; metformin 1000 mg twice daily; amlodipine 5 mg daily; oxycodone 5 mg every 6 hours as needed; acetaminophen 650 mg every 6 hours as needed.
The nurse compares this list with the verified home medication list and inpatient MAR before sending prescriptions to the outpatient pharmacy.
content.zh:
值班住院医生成的打印出院处方清单包括：华法林5 mg每日一次；依诺肝素40 mg皮下注射每日一次，共14天，标注为全膝关节置换术后静脉血栓栓塞预防；赖诺普利20 mg每日一次；二甲双胍1000 mg每日两次；氨氯地平5 mg每日一次；羟考酮5 mg每6小时必要时使用；对乙酰氨基酚650 mg每6小时必要时使用。
护士在将处方发送至门诊药房前，将此清单与已核实的家庭用药清单和住院给药记录进行比较。

title.zh: 阶段2：与开方者和药师澄清

content.en:
The nurse contacts the covering orthopedic resident. The resident says the enoxaparin entry was left from inpatient orders and was not intended to continue at discharge with warfarin. The resident is unsure why metformin appears as 1000 mg twice daily and asks that the prescriptions remain on hold while it is checked.
The nurse requests a clinical pharmacist reconciliation review. The pharmacist verifies that the outpatient pharmacy and admission reconciliation list metformin as 500 mg twice daily. The 1000 mg entry appears to have auto-populated from an older encounter. The pharmacist recommends correcting the discharge list. The resident enters corrected discharge orders: warfarin 5 mg daily; enoxaparin removed; metformin 500 mg twice daily; INR follow-up in 3 days with cardiology.
content.zh:
护士联系值班骨科住院医师。住院医师表示，依诺肝素条目是从住院医嘱中遗留的，并非有意让患者出院后与华法林同时继续使用。住院医师不确定为什么二甲双胍显示为1000 mg每日两次，并要求在核查期间继续暂缓处方。
护士请求临床药师进行用药核对。药师核实门诊药房记录和入院核对清单均显示二甲双胍为500 mg每日两次。1000 mg条目似乎是从较早一次就诊记录自动带入。药师建议更正出院清单。住院医师录入更正后的出院医嘱：华法林5 mg每日一次；删除依诺肝素；二甲双胍500 mg每日两次；3天后到心内科复查INR。

content.en: With the corrected discharge prescriptions verified, the nurse reviews each medication with the client and daughter. The daughter asks why the abdominal injections used in the hospital are not continuing at home. The nurse explains that the final discharge plan removed enoxaparin after prescriber-pharmacist clarification and that the family should not add injections unless a prescriber specifically orders and verifies them. The nurse reviews warfarin safety, signs of bleeding, dietary consistency with vitamin K-containing foods, the INR appointment in 3 days, avoidance of new over-the-counter NSAIDs unless approved, and the corrected metformin dose using the home pill bottle label. The client and daughter use teach-back and confirm follow-up appointments.
content.zh: 在确认更正后的出院处方后，护士与患者和女儿逐一复核每种药物。女儿询问为什么住院时腹部注射的药物不在家继续使用。护士解释，经开方者和药师澄清后，最终出院方案已删除依诺肝素；除非开方者明确开具并核实，否则家属不要自行加用注射药物。护士复习华法林安全要点、出血征象、含维生素K食物摄入保持一致、3天后复查INR、除非获准不要自行开始新的非处方NSAIDs，以及根据家中药瓶标签确认更正后的二甲双胍剂量。患者和女儿通过回授法复述，并确认后续复诊安排。

stem.en: For each finding in Stage 1, classify whether it requires clarification before discharge prescriptions are transmitted.
stem.zh: 针对阶段1中的每项发现，判断在出院处方发送前是否需要澄清。

rows.en: Discharge list includes warfarin 5 mg daily and enoxaparin 40 mg subcutaneously daily for 14 days.
rows.zh: 出院清单同时列有华法林5 mg每日一次和依诺肝素40 mg皮下注射每日一次，共14天。

rows.en: Discharge list changes metformin to 1000 mg twice daily, while the verified home list and MAR show 500 mg twice daily.
rows.zh: 出院清单将二甲双胍改为1000 mg每日两次，而已核实的家庭用药清单和给药记录均为500 mg每日两次。

rows.en: Hemoglobin is 10.8 g/dL and stable compared with postoperative day 1.
rows.zh: 血红蛋白10.8 g/dL，与术后第1天相比稳定。

rows.en: Left knee incision is clean, dry, and intact with mild surrounding ecchymosis.
rows.zh: 左膝切口清洁、干燥、完整，周围轻度瘀斑。

rows.en: Lisinopril and amlodipine doses match the verified home medication list.
rows.zh: 赖诺普利和氨氯地平剂量与已核实的家庭用药清单一致。

columns.zh: 不需要进行用药医嘱澄清

correct.en: The simultaneous warfarin/enoxaparin discharge entries and unexplained metformin dose increase are medication-reconciliation discrepancies that must be clarified before prescriptions are transmitted. The stable hemoglobin, expected incision findings, and unchanged antihypertensive doses do not by themselves indicate a discharge medication-order discrepancy.
correct.zh: 华法林与依诺肝素同时出现在出院清单上，以及二甲双胍剂量无依据增加，都是在处方发送前必须澄清的用药核对差异。血红蛋白稳定、切口表现符合预期、降压药剂量未改变，本身并不提示出院用药医嘱差异。

byChoice.en: Two anticoagulants appear on the discharge list. This may be appropriate only with a deliberate, verified plan; in this case it conflicts with the intended corrected discharge plan and must be clarified before dispensing.
byChoice.zh: 出院清单上出现两种抗凝药。只有在有明确且已核实方案时才可能合适；本案例中这与更正后的出院方案不符，发药前必须澄清。

byChoice.en: The metformin dose is doubled without a matching inpatient order or verified outpatient record. Any unverified dose change during a transition of care requires clarification.
byChoice.zh: 二甲双胍剂量被加倍，但没有相应住院医嘱或已核实的门诊记录支持。转科/出院交接中的任何未核实剂量改变都需要澄清。

byChoice.en: A stable postoperative hemoglobin requires routine interpretation but is not a discrepancy between medication lists.
byChoice.zh: 术后血红蛋白稳定需要常规解读，但并不是用药清单之间的差异。

byChoice.en: A clean, dry, intact incision with mild ecchymosis is an expected postoperative assessment finding and does not identify a medication-reconciliation error.
byChoice.zh: 切口清洁、干燥、完整并伴轻度瘀斑是术后可见的评估表现，并不提示用药核对错误。

byChoice.en: Medications that match the verified home list do not require discrepancy clarification unless another contraindication or new clinical concern is present.
byChoice.zh: 与已核实家庭用药清单一致的药物，除非另有禁忌或新的临床问题，否则不属于需澄清的差异。

testTakingStrategy.en: During medication reconciliation, compare lists for additions, omissions, dose changes, duplications, and route/frequency changes; then prioritize high-alert medications.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 进行用药核对时，比较清单中的新增、遗漏、剂量改变、重复用药以及给药途径/频次改变；随后优先处理高警示药物。

glossary.defZh: 在转科、入院或出院时系统比较不同来源的用药清单，以发现遗漏、重复、剂量或频次错误。
同一治疗目的的药物被重复开具，可能增加不良反应或毒性。
Medication Administration Record，记录住院期间实际给药情况的护理文件。

stem.en: Which action should the nurse take first after identifying the Stage 1 discrepancies?
stem.zh: 发现阶段1中的差异后，护士应首先采取哪项行动？

options.en: Delete enoxaparin from the list because the nurse recognizes it as a duplicate anticoagulant.
options.zh: 护士发现依诺肝素是重复抗凝药，因此自行从清单中删除。

options.en: Proceed with teaching because the client has no current signs of bleeding.
options.zh: 由于患者目前没有出血征象，因此继续进行出院宣教。

options.en: Transmit the prescriptions so the pharmacy can begin filling them, then call about the metformin dose.
options.zh: 先发送处方让药房开始配药，然后再致电询问二甲双胍剂量。

options.en: Hold the discharge prescription transmission and clarify the duplicate anticoagulant and metformin dose with the prescriber.
options.zh: 暂缓发送出院处方，并与开方者澄清抗凝药重复和二甲双胍剂量问题。

correct.en: The nurse should stop the prescriptions from reaching the outpatient pharmacy until the prescriber clarifies both discrepancies. Duplicate anticoagulant therapy is the more urgent safety concern, but the unverified metformin dose change also requires resolution. The nurse should not independently alter a prescribed discharge medication list.
correct.zh: 护士应在开方者澄清两个差异前，阻止处方发送至门诊药房。重复抗凝治疗是更紧急的安全问题，但未经核实的二甲双胍剂量改变也必须解决。护士不能自行更改已开具的出院用药清单。

byChoice.en: Recognizing the problem is correct, but independently deleting a prescribed medication is outside the nurse's authority without an order change.
byChoice.zh: 识别问题是正确的，但没有医嘱更改时自行删除处方药物超出护士权限。

byChoice.en: Sending the list allows a potentially harmful anticoagulant duplication to be dispensed before clarification.
byChoice.zh: 发送清单可能使有害的抗凝药重复在澄清前被配发给患者。

byChoice.en: Holding transmission prevents either discrepancy from reaching the patient and keeps the nurse within scope by seeking prescriber clarification.
byChoice.zh: 暂缓发送可防止任何差异到达患者，同时通过寻求开方者澄清使护士行为保持在职责范围内。

byChoice.en: Absence of current bleeding does not make an unsafe discharge prescription list acceptable.
byChoice.zh: 目前没有出血并不代表不安全的出院处方清单可以接受。

testTakingStrategy.en: For transition-of-care questions, ask what action prevents the error from reaching the client while staying within nursing scope.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 遇到交接/出院过渡问题时，思考哪项措施既能阻止错误到达患者，又符合护士职责范围。

glossary.defZh: 一旦使用错误，可能造成严重伤害的药物类别。
在医嘱不清、矛盾或可能不安全时，联系有开方权限者确认或更正。
护士依法和机构政策允许执行的职责边界。

stem.en: The resident is unsure whether the metformin dose change was intentional and says the enoxaparin was not meant to continue. Which nursing actions are appropriate? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 住院医师不确定二甲双胍剂量改变是否有意为之，并表示依诺肝素并非打算继续使用。哪些护理行动合适？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Recheck the final discharge list against the verified home list, MAR, and pharmacist documentation before teaching.
options.zh: 宣教前将最终出院清单与已核实家庭用药清单、给药记录和药师记录再次核对。

options.en: Request that discharge prescriptions remain on hold until corrected orders are entered.
options.zh: 要求在录入更正医嘱前继续暂缓出院处方。

options.en: Remove enoxaparin from the discharge list after the resident verbally agrees it should come off.
options.zh: 住院医师口头同意删除后，护士自行将依诺肝素从出院清单中移除。

options.en: Consult the clinical pharmacist to verify the medication history and outpatient dispensing record.
options.zh: 咨询临床药师，核实用药史和门诊配药记录。

options.en: Tell the daughter that both anticoagulants should be continued until the INR is therapeutic unless bleeding occurs.
options.zh: 告诉女儿，在INR达到治疗范围前应继续两种抗凝药，除非发生出血。

options.en: Ask the prescriber to enter any needed medication changes rather than changing the discharge list independently.
options.zh: 要求开方者录入所需用药更改，而不是护士自行修改出院清单。

correct.en: Appropriate actions include keeping prescriptions on hold, obtaining corrected provider orders, involving the pharmacist for formal reconciliation, and closing the loop by rechecking the final list. The nurse should not independently remove medications or give family teaching that contradicts the verified discharge plan.
correct.zh: 合适的行动包括继续暂缓处方、取得更正后的医嘱、请药师进行正式用药核对，并通过再次核对最终清单完成闭环。护士不应自行删除药物，也不应给予与已核实出院方案相矛盾的家属宣教。

byChoice.en: A pharmacist is an appropriate interdisciplinary resource for verifying medication history and resolving reconciliation conflicts.
byChoice.zh: 药师是核实用药史并解决用药核对冲突的合适跨专业资源。

byChoice.en: Final re-verification catches partial updates, auto-populated entries, or residual list errors before teaching and discharge.
byChoice.zh: 最终再次核对可在宣教和出院前发现部分更新、自动带入条目或残留清单错误。

byChoice.en: Medication discontinuations or dose corrections require prescriber action; the nurse can identify and escalate but not independently rewrite the orders.
byChoice.zh: 停药或剂量更正需要开方者处理；护士可以识别并上报，但不能独立重写医嘱。

byChoice.en: Holding the prescriptions prevents unverified medication changes from being dispensed.
byChoice.zh: 暂缓处方可防止未经核实的用药改变被配发。

byChoice.en: A verbal agreement should lead to a corrected order, not an independent nursing deletion from the official discharge prescription list.
byChoice.zh: 口头同意应转化为更正医嘱，而不是护士自行从正式出院处方清单中删除。

byChoice.en: This teaches an unverified duplicate-anticoagulant plan. The family should follow the corrected discharge list and prescribed INR follow-up.
byChoice.zh: 这会宣教未经核实的重复抗凝方案。家属应遵循更正后的出院清单和规定的INR复查计划。

testTakingStrategy.en: When a prescriber is uncertain, use escalation and verification resources; do not solve order conflicts by acting outside nursing authority.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 当开方者不确定时，应使用上报和核实资源；不要通过超出护士权限的行为解决医嘱冲突。

glossary.defZh: 参与用药核对、药物安全评估和用药教育的药学专业人员。
社区或门诊药房记录的实际配药药物、剂量和日期。
在安全问题无法由当前人员解决时，联系更合适的专业人员或上级。

stem.en: After the pharmacist verifies the errors and the resident enters corrected discharge orders, place the nursing actions in the best sequence.
stem.zh: 药师核实错误且住院医师录入更正后的出院医嘱后，请将护理行动按最佳顺序排列。

options.en: Use teach-back to verify warfarin precautions, metformin dose, and follow-up appointments.
options.zh: 使用回授法核实华法林注意事项、二甲双胍剂量和复诊安排。

options.en: Compare the corrected discharge prescriptions with the verified home list and pharmacist reconciliation documentation.
options.zh: 将更正后的出院处方与已核实家庭用药清单和药师用药核对记录进行比较。

options.en: Confirm that enoxaparin is removed, metformin is 500 mg twice daily, and INR follow-up instructions are present.
options.zh: 确认依诺肝素已删除、二甲双胍为500 mg每日两次，并有INR复查说明。

options.en: Review the corrected medication list, purposes, doses, timing, and safety precautions with the client and daughter.
options.zh: 与患者和女儿复习更正后的用药清单、用途、剂量、时间和安全注意事项。

options.en: Document the discrepancies found, communications, corrected orders, teaching, and teach-back response.
options.zh: 记录发现的差异、沟通内容、更正医嘱、宣教以及回授反应。

correct.en: The nurse first verifies that the corrected list actually matches the pharmacist-supported reconciliation, then confirms the specific high-risk corrections and INR follow-up. Teaching comes after the list is verified; teach-back evaluates understanding; documentation records the full safety intervention and education.
correct.zh: 护士首先确认更正后的清单确实与药师支持的用药核对结果一致，然后确认具体的高风险更正和INR随访。只有在清单核实后才进行宣教；回授法用于评估理解；文件记录完整的安全干预和宣教过程。

byChoice.en: After comparing sources, the nurse confirms that the exact safety-critical items were fixed and that INR follow-up is included.
byChoice.zh: 比较各来源后，护士确认关键安全项目已准确更正，并包含INR随访。

byChoice.en: This is first because a corrected order does not guarantee that the discharge list displayed to the patient is correct.
byChoice.zh: 这一步应最先进行，因为医嘱已更正并不保证显示给患者的出院清单也正确。

byChoice.en: Teaching should use only the verified medication list to avoid reinforcing an old or erroneous plan.
byChoice.zh: 宣教应只使用已核实的用药清单，以免强化旧方案或错误方案。

byChoice.en: Teach-back evaluates whether the patient and caregiver can explain the plan and warning signs in their own words.
byChoice.zh: 回授法评估患者和照护者是否能用自己的话解释方案和警示征象。

byChoice.en: Documentation follows the completed intervention and creates a record of the discrepancy, escalation, correction, and education.
byChoice.zh: 记录应在干预完成后进行，形成差异、上报、更正和宣教的记录。

testTakingStrategy.en: For ordered-response discharge items, sequence from verification, to teaching, to evaluation of understanding, to documentation.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 出院相关排序题通常按“核实—宣教—评估理解—记录”的顺序思考。

glossary.defZh: 让患者或照护者用自己的话复述重点，以确认理解程度。
监测华法林抗凝强度的实验室指标。
确认问题已被识别、传达、处理，并在最终输出中正确反映。

stem.en: During Stage 3 teaching, the daughter asks why the client is not continuing the abdominal injections at home. Complete the nurse's teaching statement.
stem.zh: 在阶段3宣教中，女儿询问为什么患者回家后不继续腹部注射。请完成护士的宣教语句。

clozeStem.en: Enoxaparin was used in the hospital as {{1}} while warfarin was being restarted. At home, the client should {{2}} and seek urgent help for {{3}}.
clozeStem.zh: 住院期间，依诺肝素在华法林重新开始期间作为 {{1}} 使用。回家后，患者应 {{2}}，并在出现 {{3}} 时立即求助。

options.en: temporary anticoagulant bridging ordered during the inpatient stay
options.zh: 住院期间医嘱使用的临时桥接抗凝

options.en: a medication for incision pain
options.zh: 用于切口疼痛的药物

options.en: a permanent replacement for warfarin
options.zh: 华法林的永久替代药

options.en: continue any injections used in the hospital until all syringes are gone
options.zh: 继续使用住院时用过的所有注射药，直到针剂用完

options.en: stop warfarin until the orthopedic follow-up visit
options.zh: 暂停华法林直到骨科复诊

options.en: follow the corrected discharge list and not add injections unless specifically prescribed and verified
options.zh: 遵循更正后的出院清单，除非有明确且已核实的医嘱，否则不要自行加用注射药物

options.en: increased appetite after returning home
options.zh: 回家后食欲增加

options.en: mild expected knee soreness after therapy
options.zh: 治疗后轻度、符合预期的膝部酸痛

options.en: blood in urine or stool, prolonged bleeding, severe headache, dizziness, or unusual bruising
options.zh: 尿中或大便带血、出血不止、严重头痛、头晕或异常瘀斑

correct.en: Bridging decisions are individualized and should be taught from the verified discharge orders. In this case, enoxaparin was removed after prescriber-pharmacist clarification, so the family should follow the corrected list and recognize bleeding warning signs while warfarin is continued with INR follow-up.
correct.zh: 桥接抗凝决策需要个体化处理，宣教应依据已核实的出院医嘱。本案例中，经开方者和药师澄清后已删除依诺肝素，因此家属应遵循更正后的清单，并在继续华法林和复查INR期间识别出血警示征象。

byChoice.en: Enoxaparin was used as temporary inpatient anticoagulant bridging while warfarin was held and restarted; it was not a pain medication or permanent replacement in this plan.
byChoice.zh: 依诺肝素是在华法林暂停并重新开始期间作为住院临时桥接抗凝使用；在本方案中它不是止痛药，也不是永久替代药。

byChoice.en: The safe instruction is to follow the verified corrected discharge list. Continuing injections from the hospital or stopping warfarin would contradict the corrected plan.
byChoice.zh: 安全宣教是遵循已核实、更正后的出院清单。继续住院注射药或停用华法林都与更正方案相矛盾。

byChoice.en: Bleeding symptoms require prompt reporting or urgent evaluation for a client taking warfarin; mild expected knee soreness and appetite change are not the priority bleeding warnings.
byChoice.zh: 服用华法林的患者若出现出血相关症状，应及时报告或紧急评估；轻度符合预期的膝部酸痛和食欲变化不是重点出血警示。

testTakingStrategy.en: Use patient teaching to close safety gaps: explain the reason for the change, give concrete warning signs, and verify follow-up.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 利用患者宣教弥合安全缺口：解释变更原因，给出具体警示征象，并确认随访。

glossary.defZh: 一种低分子肝素抗凝药，常通过皮下注射给药。
口服抗凝药，需要通过INR监测抗凝强度。
减少出血风险并识别出血警示征象的用药安全教育。

stem.en: Which documentation best reflects the nurse's role in this discharge medication-reconciliation event?
stem.zh: 哪项记录最能体现护士在此次出院用药核对事件中的作用？

options.en: Client discharged after routine medication teaching. Daughter present.
options.zh: 患者完成常规用药宣教后出院。女儿在场。

options.en: Enoxaparin removed from discharge list because it duplicated warfarin; metformin dose corrected by nurse after discussion.
options.zh: 因依诺肝素与华法林重复，护士已将其从出院清单中删除；讨论后护士更正二甲双胍剂量。

options.en: Medication discrepancy found, but corrected orders are visible in the electronic health record; no additional documentation needed.
options.zh: 发现用药差异，但更正医嘱已显示在电子健康记录中；无需额外记录。

options.en: Resident and pharmacist notified of duplicate anticoagulant and unverified metformin dose; prescriptions held pending clarification; corrected orders verified; warfarin, metformin, bleeding precautions, INR follow-up, and teach-back documented.
options.zh: 已通知住院医师和药师存在抗凝药重复及二甲双胍剂量未核实；处方在澄清期间暂缓；已核实更正医嘱；已记录华法林、二甲双胍、出血预防、INR随访及回授情况。

correct.en: Documentation should record the specific discrepancies, escalation to prescriber and pharmacist, the hold on prescriptions, the corrected orders, teaching content, follow-up, and teach-back response. This supports continuity of care and creates an audit trail without claiming the nurse independently changed prescriptions.
correct.zh: 记录应包括具体差异、向开方者和药师上报、暂缓处方、更正医嘱、宣教内容、随访安排和回授反应。这有助于照护连续性并形成审计轨迹，同时不声称护士独立更改了处方。

byChoice.en: This accurately captures the safety intervention, interdisciplinary communication, final verification, teaching, follow-up, and patient/caregiver understanding.
byChoice.zh: 此项准确记录了安全干预、跨专业沟通、最终核实、宣教、随访以及患者/照护者理解情况。

byChoice.en: This incorrectly implies the nurse independently removed and corrected prescribed medications, which is not the appropriate scope-based process.
byChoice.zh: 此项错误暗示护士独立删除并更正处方药物，不符合基于职责范围的正确流程。

byChoice.en: Corrected orders alone do not document the nurse's assessment, escalation, education, or patient/caregiver understanding.
byChoice.zh: 仅有更正医嘱不能记录护士的评估、上报、宣教或患者/照护者理解。

byChoice.en: This is too vague and omits the medication safety event, communications, corrected orders, and teach-back.
byChoice.zh: 此记录过于笼统，遗漏了用药安全事件、沟通、更正医嘱和回授。

testTakingStrategy.en: Good documentation is specific, objective, chronological, and clear about who performed each action.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 良好的记录应具体、客观、按时间顺序，并清楚说明每项行动由谁执行。

glossary.defZh: 能显示问题发现、沟通、处理和结果的可追踪记录。
不同照护者和机构之间保持信息一致，以支持安全接续照护。
基于事实、观察、沟通内容和已执行行动的记录，而非主观判断。

correct.en: This case emphasizes that discharge medication reconciliation is an active safety process, not a paperwork step. The nurse detects two discrepancies before prescriptions are transmitted: a duplicate anticoagulant entry and an unsupported metformin dose increase. Because anticoagulants are high-risk medications and the client has reduced kidney function, the nurse prevents the list from reaching the pharmacy, clarifies the orders with the prescriber, brings in the pharmacist for formal reconciliation, verifies the final corrected list, teaches the client and caregiver using the verified plan, and documents the full closed-loop intervention. Perioperative bridging plans are individualized; the safe nursing judgment is to verify this client's final discharge plan before the family follows it.
correct.zh: 本案例强调，出院用药核对是主动的安全流程，而不是单纯文书步骤。护士在处方发送前发现两个差异：抗凝药重复条目，以及缺乏依据的二甲双胍剂量增加。由于抗凝药属于高风险用药，且患者肾功能下降，护士阻止清单进入药房流程，与开方者澄清医嘱，邀请药师进行正式用药核对，核实最终更正清单，使用已核实方案对患者和照护者宣教，并记录完整闭环干预。围手术期桥接抗凝方案需要个体化处理；安全的护理判断是先核实该患者最终出院方案，再让家属按方案执行。

testTakingStrategy.en: In unfolding medication-reconciliation cases, follow the chain: recognize discrepancies, prioritize the highest-harm medication risk, clarify through the correct discipline, verify the final list, teach from the verified list, and document the loop.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 在展开式用药核对案例中，按以下链条思考：识别差异，优先处理潜在伤害最大的用药风险，通过正确专业人员澄清，核实最终清单，基于已核实清单宣教，并记录闭环。

glossary.defZh: 出院时比较家庭用药、住院给药和出院处方，确保患者离院后使用的药物准确、安全。
降低血栓形成风险、但会增加出血风险的药物。
肾功能长期下降，可能影响部分药物清除和用药安全。
患者在不同照护地点或团队之间转移时的信息和责任交接过程。

stem.en: Review the client record and answer the case-study items.
stem.zh: 阅读患者病历并回答案例题。

title.en: Unfolding case: postoperative opioid-induced respiratory depression
title.zh: 进展性案例：术后阿片类药物相关呼吸抑制

summary.en: A postoperative client with obstructive sleep apnea becomes difficult to arouse after repeated IV morphine doses. The nurse must recognize opioid-related respiratory compromise, intervene at the bedside, escalate appropriately, anticipate titrated naloxone, and monitor for recurrent sedation.
summary.zh: 一名有阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停病史的术后患者在多次接受静脉吗啡后变得难以唤醒。护士需要识别阿片类药物相关的呼吸受损，立即采取床旁干预，适当升级处理，预期按规程小剂量滴定纳洛酮，并监测再次镇静。

content.en:
58-year-old man, 14 hours after open right hemicolectomy for a cecal mass. History: obstructive sleep apnea (uses CPAP at home and brought machine to hospital), obesity (BMI 38), hypertension controlled with hydrochlorothiazide 25 mg daily, GERD treated with pantoprazole 40 mg daily. No known drug allergies.

Postoperative orders: morphine sulfate 4 mg IV every 3 hours PRN moderate-to-severe pain; ondansetron 4 mg IV every 6 hours PRN nausea; lactated Ringer's at 125 mL/hr; sequential compression devices; incentive spirometry every 2 hours while awake; continuous pulse oximetry. CPAP machine is at bedside but has not been applied since surgery because the client has mostly been upright and awake.

Morphine doses received: 0200, 0500, and 0745. Current time: 0830.
content.zh:
58岁男性，因盲肠肿块行开放性右半结肠切除术后14小时。病史：阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停（在家使用CPAP，已将机器带到医院）、肥胖（BMI 38）、高血压（每日氢氯噻嗪25 mg控制良好）、胃食管反流病（每日泮托拉唑40 mg）。无已知药物过敏。

术后医嘱：硫酸吗啡4 mg静脉注射，每3小时一次按需用于中重度疼痛；昂丹司琼4 mg静脉注射，每6小时一次按需用于恶心；乳酸林格液125 mL/小时；双侧序贯加压装置；清醒时每2小时使用激励性肺量计；连续脉搏血氧监测。CPAP机器在床旁，但术后尚未使用，因为患者大多保持坐起且清醒。

已接受吗啡时间：0200、0500、0745。当前时间：0830。

content.en:
0715 handoff: awake, conversational, oriented x4. Pain 6/10 at rest; reports morphine "takes the edge off but doesn't last." Using incentive spirometry independently.

Vital signs: T 99 °F (37.2 °C), HR 82/min, BP 138/84 mm Hg, RR 16/min, SpO2 95% on room air. Pupils 4 mm bilaterally, equal and reactive. Pasero Opioid-Induced Sedation Scale (POSS): 1, awake and alert. Abdominal dressing dry and intact; Jackson-Pratt drain with 40 mL serosanguineous drainage. Bowel sounds absent. Foley catheter: 280 mL clear yellow urine over previous 4 hours. Sequential compression devices in place; pedal pulses palpable.

0600 labs: WBC 11.2 ×10³/µL; hemoglobin 11.4 g/dL (preoperative 13.8 g/dL); hematocrit 34.2%; platelets 210 ×10³/µL; sodium 139 mEq/L; potassium 3.9 mEq/L; chloride 101 mEq/L; CO2 26 mEq/L; BUN 18 mg/dL; creatinine 1.0 mg/dL; glucose 168 mg/dL; calcium 8.6 mg/dL. Coagulation studies within expected limits.
content.zh:
0715交接班：清醒、能交谈，定向力（人、地点、时间、情境）均正常。静息疼痛6/10；表示吗啡“能缓解一些，但维持不了多久”。可独立使用激励性肺量计。

生命体征：体温99 °F (37.2 °C)，心率82次/分，血压138/84 mm Hg，呼吸16次/分，室内空气SpO2 95%。双侧瞳孔4 mm，等大等圆，对光反应存在。Pasero阿片类药物诱导镇静量表（POSS）：1分，清醒警觉。腹部敷料干燥完整；Jackson-Pratt引流管有40 mL血清血性引流液。肠鸣音消失。Foley导尿管：过去4小时清亮黄色尿液280 mL。序贯加压装置已使用；足背动脉搏动可触及。

0600实验室：白细胞11.2 ×10³/µL；血红蛋白11.4 g/dL（术前13.8 g/dL）；红细胞压积34.2%；血小板210 ×10³/µL；钠139 mEq/L；钾3.9 mEq/L；氯101 mEq/L；CO2 26 mEq/L；BUN 18 mg/dL；肌酐1.0 mg/dL；葡萄糖168 mg/dL；钙8.6 mg/dL。凝血检查在预期范围内。

title.en: 0830 update: 45 minutes after the 0745 morphine dose

content.en:
The nurse enters for a scheduled assessment and finds the client slumped to one side with eyes closed. He does not respond to his name at normal volume. With loud verbal stimulation and firm tactile stimulation, he briefly opens his eyes, mumbles "I'm fine," and falls back asleep within seconds.

Vital signs: HR 68/min, BP 118/70 mm Hg, RR 8/min and shallow, SpO2 89% on room air. Pupils 2 mm bilaterally, constricted but reactive. POSS: 3, frequently drowsy and difficult to arouse. Pulse oximetry alarm is sounding. Lactated Ringer's is infusing. Next PRN morphine dose is not due until 1045. Abdominal dressing remains dry. Jackson-Pratt output has not changed appreciably. Foley output over the past hour is 20 mL.
content.zh:
护士按计划进入病房评估，发现患者斜靠在床上一侧，双眼闭合。护士用正常音量呼唤姓名时无反应。大声语言刺激和较强触觉刺激后，患者短暂睁眼，含糊地说“我没事”，随后数秒内再次入睡。

生命体征：心率68次/分，血压118/70 mm Hg，呼吸8次/分且浅，室内空气SpO2 89%。双侧瞳孔2 mm，缩小但对光反应存在。POSS：3分，经常嗜睡且难以唤醒。脉搏血氧报警正在响。乳酸林格液正在输注。下一次按需吗啡最早到1045才可给。腹部敷料仍干燥。Jackson-Pratt引流量无明显变化。过去1小时Foley尿量20 mL。

title.en: 0838 update: limited response to initial bedside measures
title.zh: 0838更新：初始床旁措施反应有限

title.en: Respiratory status after stimulation, positioning, and oxygen
title.zh: 刺激、体位调整和给氧后的呼吸状态

content.en:
The nurse has elevated the head of bed to 30 degrees, applied oxygen by nasal cannula at 2 L/min, and continued verbal and tactile stimulation while staying with the client. The client remains minimally responsive, opens eyes only to repeated loud commands, and does not follow instructions to take a deep breath.

Vital signs: HR 62/min, BP 108/66 mm Hg, RR 7/min, SpO2 91% on 2 L/min nasal cannula. POSS remains 3. Respiratory effort is labored with audible snoring respirations and intermittent 6- to 8-second apneic pauses. No additional opioids have been given. The rapid response team has been activated, and the on-call provider has been notified. Naloxone 0.4 mg/mL is available on the unit.
content.zh:
护士已将床头抬高至30度，经鼻导管给予氧气2 L/分，并在床旁持续进行语言和触觉刺激。患者仍反应极少，仅在反复大声指令下睁眼，不能按指令深呼吸。

生命体征：心率62次/分，血压108/66 mm Hg，呼吸7次/分，经鼻导管2 L/分吸氧时SpO2 91%。POSS仍为3分。呼吸费力，可听到鼾样呼吸，并间歇出现6至8秒呼吸暂停。未再给予其他阿片类药物。快速反应团队已启动，值班医务人员已通知。病区可取得纳洛酮0.4 mg/mL。

title.en: 0855 update: after titrated naloxone and rapid response intervention
title.zh: 0855更新：小剂量滴定纳洛酮和快速反应干预后

content.en:
Rapid response team arrived at 0842. Naloxone 0.04 mg IV was administered at 0843 per protocol/order, with a second 0.04 mg IV dose at 0846 for partial response. By 0850, the client opens eyes spontaneously, follows commands, and takes deeper breaths when prompted.

0855 vital signs: HR 78/min, BP 126/78 mm Hg, RR 14/min, SpO2 94% on 2 L/min nasal cannula. Pupils 3 mm bilaterally. POSS: 2, slightly drowsy and easy to arouse. The client reports incisional pain 7/10 and asks, "Can I get something for this pain?" The morphine order has been discontinued. The surgical team is considering multimodal analgesia alternatives. The team notes that naloxone may wear off before the previously administered morphine effect is fully resolved.
content.zh:
快速反应团队于0842到达。按规程/医嘱于0843给予纳洛酮0.04 mg静脉注射；因反应部分，于0846再次给予0.04 mg静脉注射。到0850，患者可自主睁眼，能听从指令，并在提示下加深呼吸。

0855生命体征：心率78次/分，血压126/78 mm Hg，呼吸14次/分，经鼻导管2 L/分吸氧时SpO2 94%。双侧瞳孔3 mm。POSS：2分，轻度嗜睡但容易唤醒。患者报告切口疼痛7/10，并问：“能不能给我止痛药？”吗啡医嘱已停用。外科团队正在考虑多模式镇痛方案。团队指出，纳洛酮作用可能在此前给予的吗啡效应完全消退前减弱。

stem.en: At 0830, how should the nurse interpret each assessment cue?
stem.zh: 0830时，护士应如何解读每项评估线索？

rows.en: POSS score 3; opens eyes only briefly with loud voice and firm tactile stimulation
rows.zh: POSS 3分；仅在大声呼唤和较强触觉刺激后短暂睁眼

rows.en: RR 8/min and shallow with SpO2 89% on room air
rows.zh: 呼吸8次/分且浅，室内空气SpO2 89%

rows.en: Pupils 2 mm bilaterally, constricted but reactive
rows.zh: 双侧瞳孔2 mm，缩小但对光反应存在

rows.en: Abdominal dressing dry and Jackson-Pratt output not appreciably increased
rows.zh: 腹部敷料干燥，Jackson-Pratt引流量无明显增加

columns.en: Would more strongly support bleeding or hypovolemia
columns.zh: 更支持出血或低血容量

columns.en: Decreases concern for bleeding as the primary cause
columns.zh: 降低出血作为主要原因的可能性
支持阿片类药物相关呼吸抑制

correct.en: The most concerning pattern is new oversedation with hypoventilation, oxygen desaturation, and miosis within the expected post-IV morphine effect window. The dry dressing and unchanged drain output make active surgical bleeding less likely as the primary explanation, although perfusion and urine output still require monitoring.
correct.zh: 最令人担忧的模式是在静脉吗啡作用时间窗内出现新的过度镇静、通气不足、血氧下降和瞳孔缩小。敷料干燥且引流量无明显变化，使活动性手术出血作为主要解释的可能性降低，但灌注和尿量仍需监测。

byChoice.en: A POSS score of 3 with difficulty sustaining arousal after recent opioid administration is a major cue for opioid oversedation.
byChoice.zh: 近期使用阿片类药物后出现POSS 3分且难以维持清醒，是阿片类药物过度镇静的重要线索。

byChoice.en: A shallow respiratory rate of 8/min with desaturation shows clinically significant hypoventilation rather than simple fatigue.
byChoice.zh: 浅慢呼吸8次/分并伴血氧下降，提示有临床意义的通气不足，而不是单纯疲劳。

byChoice.en: Bilateral miosis in this context supports an opioid effect; it would not be expected from uncomplicated hypovolemia or postoperative bleeding.
byChoice.zh: 在此情境下双侧瞳孔缩小支持阿片类药物效应；单纯低血容量或术后出血通常不会导致这种表现。

byChoice.en: A dry dressing and stable drain output do not rule out all complications, but they make acute external or drain-visible bleeding less likely as the primary cause of the sudden sedation and hypoventilation.
byChoice.zh: 敷料干燥且引流量稳定不能排除所有并发症，但使可见的急性出血作为突然镇静和通气不足主要原因的可能性降低。

testTakingStrategy.en: Cluster cues instead of chasing one abnormal value. Sedation plus slow respirations plus miosis after an opioid is more specific than a mild blood pressure drop alone.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 把线索组合起来判断，不要只追一个异常数值。使用阿片类药物后出现镇静、呼吸减慢和瞳孔缩小，比单独轻度血压下降更具特异性。

glossary.termZh: Pasero阿片类药物诱导镇静量表
glossary.defZh: 用于评估接受阿片类药物患者镇静程度和呼吸抑制风险的量表。
瞳孔直径变小；在阿片类药物作用或中毒时常见。
呼吸频率或深度不足，导致氧合下降和/或二氧化碳潴留。

stem.en: At 0830, which immediate nursing actions are appropriate while the nurse remains with the client? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 0830时，护士留在患者身边时应立即采取哪些护理措施？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Use loud verbal and tactile stimulation to encourage breathing and assess arousability.
options.zh: 使用大声语言和触觉刺激以促进呼吸并评估可唤醒程度。

options.en: Hold any further opioid dose and reassess sedation and respiratory status before additional analgesia is given.
options.zh: 暂停任何进一步阿片类药物给药，并在给予额外镇痛前重新评估镇静和呼吸状态。

options.en: Administer another IV morphine dose if the client wakes and reports severe pain.
options.zh: 如果患者醒来并报告剧烈疼痛，则再给予一次静脉吗啡。

options.en: Apply supplemental oxygen and continue close respiratory monitoring.
options.zh: 给予补充氧气并继续密切监测呼吸。

options.en: Reposition the client to support the airway, such as elevating the head of bed as tolerated.
options.zh: 调整患者体位以支持气道，例如在可耐受情况下抬高床头。

options.en: Document that the client is sleeping and return in 30 minutes to allow rest.
options.zh: 记录患者正在睡眠，30分钟后再回来以便其休息。

correct.en: The client has opioid oversedation with hypoventilation. Immediate nursing actions focus on preventing additional opioid exposure, stimulating respirations, supporting airway positioning, providing oxygen, and reassessing continuously while escalating if the response is inadequate.
correct.zh: 患者出现阿片类药物过度镇静并伴通气不足。立即护理措施应集中于避免继续暴露于阿片类药物、刺激呼吸、通过体位支持气道、给氧，并在反应不足时持续评估和升级处理。

byChoice.en: Correct. Stimulation can temporarily improve respiratory effort and helps determine whether the client can sustain arousal.
byChoice.zh: 正确。刺激可暂时改善呼吸努力，并帮助判断患者能否维持清醒。

byChoice.en: Correct. Oxygen treats hypoxemia, but it must be paired with ventilation assessment because oxygen alone does not reverse opioid-related hypoventilation.
byChoice.zh: 正确。氧气可处理低氧血症，但必须同时评估通气，因为单纯给氧不能逆转阿片类药物相关通气不足。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. POSS 3, RR 8/min, and SpO2 89% represent an urgent respiratory safety problem, not therapeutic rest.
byChoice.zh: 错误。POSS 3分、呼吸8次/分和SpO2 89%表示紧急呼吸安全问题，不是治疗性休息。

byChoice.en: Correct. Further opioids could worsen respiratory depression until the client is reassessed and the analgesic plan is changed.
byChoice.zh: 正确。进一步使用阿片类药物可能加重呼吸抑制，应先重新评估并调整镇痛方案。

byChoice.en: Correct. Airway positioning is especially important because obstructive sleep apnea and snoring respirations can compound central opioid depression.
byChoice.zh: 正确。由于阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停和鼾样呼吸会加重中枢性阿片抑制，气道体位尤其重要。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Additional morphine would increase opioid effect when the current problem is opioid-related sedation and respiratory depression.
byChoice.zh: 错误。当前问题是阿片类药物相关镇静和呼吸抑制，额外吗啡会增加阿片效应。

testTakingStrategy.en: When an opioid-treated client has decreased arousal and slow respirations, first stop adding to the cause and support airway and breathing.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 接受阿片治疗的患者出现清醒度下降和呼吸减慢时，先停止增加诱因，并支持气道和呼吸。

glossary.defZh: 通过鼻导管、面罩等方式给予高于空气氧浓度的氧气，以改善氧合。
通过抬高床头、调整头颈或侧卧等方式帮助保持气道通畅。
呼吸频率和/或深度下降，可能导致低氧和二氧化碳潴留。

stem.en: At 0838, the client remains minimally responsive with RR 7/min, snoring respirations, apneic pauses, and SpO2 91% despite stimulation, repositioning, and 2 L/min oxygen. Which action is the priority?
stem.zh: 0838时，尽管已进行刺激、调整体位并给予2 L/分氧气，患者仍反应极少，呼吸7次/分，有鼾样呼吸、呼吸暂停，SpO2 91%。优先行动是什么？

options.en: Activate or confirm rapid response activation, notify the provider, support ventilation, and prepare naloxone for administration per protocol or order.
options.zh: 启动或确认快速反应团队已启动，通知医务人员，支持通气，并准备按规程或医嘱给予纳洛酮。

options.en: Continue stimulation and increase oxygen flow; reassess in 15 minutes because SpO2 improved from 89% to 91%.
options.zh: 继续刺激并增加氧流量；因SpO2从89%升至91%，15分钟后再评估。

options.en: Administer the next PRN morphine dose early because uncontrolled postoperative pain may be causing shallow breathing.
options.zh: 提前给予下一次按需吗啡，因为未控制的术后疼痛可能导致浅呼吸。

options.en: Apply the home CPAP machine and delay further escalation unless the oxygen saturation falls below 88%.
options.zh: 使用家用CPAP机器，除非血氧低于88%，否则暂缓进一步升级处理。

correct.en: Persistent hypoventilation, apneic pauses, and inability to follow breathing commands after initial measures indicate that conservative bedside measures are not enough. The nurse should bring emergency support to the bedside, notify the prescriber, continue airway and ventilation support, and prepare naloxone according to facility protocol or order.
correct.zh: 在初始措施后仍持续通气不足、出现呼吸暂停且不能按指令呼吸，说明保守床旁措施不足。护士应将紧急支援带到床旁，通知开具医嘱者，继续支持气道和通气，并按机构规程或医嘱准备纳洛酮。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. CPAP may help obstructive events after the client is stable, but it does not replace urgent evaluation and reversal of opioid-related central respiratory depression.
byChoice.zh: 错误。患者稳定后CPAP可能有助于阻塞性事件，但不能替代对阿片类药物相关中枢性呼吸抑制的紧急评估和逆转。

byChoice.en: Correct. This option addresses the failing airway/breathing problem and frames naloxone administration within protocol or prescriber authorization.
byChoice.zh: 正确。该选项处理正在恶化的气道/呼吸问题，并将纳洛酮给药置于规程或开嘱授权框架内。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Giving more opioid to a minimally responsive client with RR 7/min is unsafe and could worsen respiratory compromise.
byChoice.zh: 错误。对反应极少且呼吸7次/分的患者继续给予阿片类药物不安全，可能加重呼吸受损。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. A small SpO2 improvement can mask ongoing hypoventilation; the persistent RR 7/min and apneic pauses require escalation.
byChoice.zh: 错误。SpO2轻度改善可能掩盖持续通气不足；呼吸仍为7次/分并有呼吸暂停，需要升级处理。

testTakingStrategy.en: Do not let a slightly better oxygen saturation distract from ventilation failure. Slow respirations and apnea after opioids are escalation cues.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 不要被血氧略有改善分散注意力。阿片类药物后出现呼吸减慢和呼吸暂停，是需要升级处理的线索。

glossary.defZh: 在患者病情恶化但尚未心肺骤停时被呼叫到床旁的跨专业紧急支援团队。
短时间停止呼吸，可提示严重通气受损或气道阻塞。
阿片受体拮抗剂，可逆转阿片类药物导致的呼吸抑制和镇静。

stem.en: Complete the statement about naloxone use for this postoperative client.
stem.zh: 完成关于该术后患者使用纳洛酮的陈述。

clozeStem.en: For this postoperative client with suspected opioid-induced respiratory depression, the nurse should anticipate naloxone by the {{1}} route in {{2}} doses, titrated to improve {{3}} while limiting abrupt loss of analgesia when possible.
clozeStem.zh: 对于这名疑似阿片类药物相关呼吸抑制的术后患者，护士应预期通过 {{1}} 途径给予纳洛酮，采用 {{2}} 剂量滴定，以改善 {{3}}，同时在可能时限制镇痛作用突然丧失。

options.en: oral
options.zh: 口服

options.en: topical
options.zh: 外用

options.en: IV
options.zh: 静脉

options.en: one full vial as a rapid bolus
options.zh: 一整瓶快速推注

options.en: small, repeated
options.zh: 小剂量、可重复

options.en: scheduled oral maintenance
options.zh: 定时口服维持

options.en: ventilation and arousability
options.zh: 通气和可唤醒程度

options.en: bowel sounds and oral intake
options.zh: 肠鸣音和经口摄入

options.en: drain color and wound approximation
options.zh: 引流液颜色和切口对合

correct.en: IV naloxone has rapid onset and can be titrated in small repeated doses in a postoperative client when the goal is to restore adequate ventilation and arousability without causing unnecessary abrupt loss of analgesia. The exact dose and dilution should follow the facility protocol or prescriber order; the case uses 0.04 mg IV increments as an example of titration.
correct.zh: 静脉纳洛酮起效快，在术后患者中可采用小剂量重复滴定，目标是恢复足够通气和可唤醒程度，同时尽量避免不必要的镇痛突然丧失。具体剂量和稀释方式应遵循机构规程或医嘱；本案例使用0.04 mg静脉递增作为滴定示例。

byChoice.en: The IV route is appropriate in this urgent monitored setting because it has rapid onset and permits careful titration.
byChoice.zh: 在此紧急且受监测的情境下，静脉途径合适，因为起效快并便于谨慎滴定。

byChoice.en: Small repeated doses reduce the risk of abruptly reversing all analgesia and triggering severe pain, sympathetic stimulation, nausea, or vomiting.
byChoice.zh: 小剂量重复给药可降低突然完全逆转镇痛、引发剧痛、交感兴奋、恶心或呕吐的风险。

byChoice.en: The target is respiratory recovery: better ventilation, safer oxygenation, and ability to sustain arousal, not complete elimination of pain.
byChoice.zh: 目标是呼吸恢复：改善通气、更安全的氧合和维持可唤醒，而不是完全消除疼痛。

testTakingStrategy.en: For reversal agents, match the dose strategy to the clinical goal. In a postoperative client, reverse dangerous respiratory depression without assuming that all analgesia must be eliminated at once.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 使用逆转药时，要让给药策略匹配临床目标。术后患者需要逆转危险的呼吸抑制，而不是假设必须一次性消除所有镇痛作用。

glossary.defZh: 根据患者反应逐步调整药物剂量，以达到治疗目标并减少不良反应。
疼痛减轻或控制。
阻断阿片受体作用的药物，可逆转阿片类药物效应。

stem.en: At 0855, the client is awake enough to follow commands after two small IV naloxone doses but reports incisional pain 7/10. What is the nurse's priority concern for the next period of care?
stem.zh: 0855时，患者在两次小剂量静脉纳洛酮后已能清醒到听从指令，但报告切口疼痛7/10。护士接下来护理阶段的优先关注点是什么？

options.en: Severe postoperative hemorrhage because the hemoglobin is lower than the preoperative value.
options.zh: 因血红蛋白低于术前值，发生严重术后出血。

options.en: Loss of anticoagulation because sequential compression devices have been in place.
options.zh: 因已使用序贯加压装置，出现抗凝不足。

options.en: Recurrent sedation and respiratory depression as naloxone effect decreases before the opioid effect has fully resolved.
options.zh: 纳洛酮作用减弱而阿片类药物效应尚未完全消退时，可能再次出现镇静和呼吸抑制。

options.en: Immediate bowel obstruction because absent bowel sounds were present at handoff.
options.zh: 因交接班时肠鸣音消失，立即发生肠梗阻。

correct.en: After naloxone response, the client can become sedated again if the antagonist effect wanes while the previously administered opioid remains active. The nurse should maintain continuous respiratory and sedation monitoring, keep escalation resources available, hold further opioids until the prescriber revises the plan, and use ordered non-opioid or nonpharmacologic pain measures as appropriate.
correct.zh: 纳洛酮起效后，如果拮抗剂作用减弱而此前给予的阿片类药物仍在发挥作用，患者可能再次镇静。护士应持续监测呼吸和镇静程度，保持升级处理资源可用，在开嘱者调整方案前暂停进一步阿片类药物，并按医嘱或适当使用非阿片或非药物止痛措施。

byChoice.en: Correct. The apparent improvement does not end the risk because naloxone may wear off before the opioid effect is gone.
byChoice.zh: 正确。表面改善并不意味着风险结束，因为纳洛酮可能在阿片效应消失前减弱。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. The lower hemoglobin requires trending and assessment, but stable dressing and drain findings make hemorrhage less urgent than recurrent respiratory depression in this moment.
byChoice.zh: 错误。血红蛋白下降需要趋势观察和评估，但敷料和引流稳定，使此刻反复呼吸抑制比出血更紧急。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Sequential compression devices are mechanical VTE prevention; they do not create a priority problem of lost anticoagulation here.
byChoice.zh: 错误。序贯加压装置是机械性静脉血栓预防措施；本情境不存在以抗凝不足为优先的问题。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Absent bowel sounds can be expected early after open abdominal surgery and do not explain the immediate post-naloxone respiratory risk.
byChoice.zh: 错误。开放腹部手术早期肠鸣音消失可为预期表现，不能解释纳洛酮后的即时呼吸风险。

testTakingStrategy.en: After an antidote works, ask whether the original drug can outlast the antidote. If yes, monitor for recurrence rather than assuming the crisis is over.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 解毒或拮抗药起效后，要问原药效应是否可能持续超过拮抗药。如果是，就要监测复发，而不是假设危机已经结束。

glossary.defZh: 拮抗药作用减弱后，残余阿片类药物效应再次导致镇静或呼吸抑制。
联合不同机制的药物和非药物方法控制疼痛，以减少单一阿片类药物负荷。
定期评估清醒程度、可唤醒性和呼吸状态，以发现药物过度镇静。

stem.en: Which findings or handoff points should the nurse communicate to help reduce recurrence of opioid-induced respiratory depression? Select all that apply.
stem.zh: 护士应在交接或沟通中说明哪些发现或要点，以帮助减少阿片类药物相关呼吸抑制再次发生？选择所有适用项。

options.en: Hydrochlorothiazide and pantoprazole are the most likely direct causes of the sedation episode.
options.zh: 氢氯噻嗪和泮托拉唑最可能是此次镇静事件的直接原因。

options.en: BMI 38, which increases risk for airway obstruction and opioid-related respiratory compromise.
options.zh: BMI 38，会增加气道阻塞和阿片类药物相关呼吸受损风险。

options.en: The client has obstructive sleep apnea and his CPAP had not been used while he was sleeping or sedated postoperatively.
options.zh: 患者有阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停，术后睡眠或镇静时未使用CPAP。

options.en: The client received three IV morphine doses within the same morning-to-shift interval, including the 0745 dose before deterioration.
options.zh: 患者在同一夜间至早班时段内接受了三次静脉吗啡，包括恶化前0745的给药。

options.en: The surgical team should reassess the analgesic plan, consider multimodal non-opioid strategies when appropriate, and continue close sedation and respiratory monitoring.
options.zh: 外科团队应重新评估镇痛方案，在适当时考虑多模式非阿片策略，并继续密切监测镇静和呼吸。

options.en: Because the client still reports pain, restarting a smaller morphine dose is the safest immediate plan.
options.zh: 因为患者仍报告疼痛，立即重新开始较小剂量吗啡是最安全计划。

correct.en: The recurrence-prevention handoff should identify patient-specific and treatment-related risk factors: obstructive sleep apnea without CPAP during sleep/sedation, obesity, and repeated IV morphine exposure. It should also prompt a revised analgesic and monitoring plan rather than simply restarting opioids after naloxone response.
correct.zh: 预防复发的交接应明确患者特异性和治疗相关风险因素：阻塞性睡眠呼吸暂停且睡眠/镇静时未用CPAP、肥胖，以及反复静脉吗啡暴露。同时应推动修订镇痛和监测方案，而不是在纳洛酮起效后简单恢复阿片类药物。

byChoice.en: Correct. Cumulative opioid exposure and timing before the event are important treatment-related risk factors to communicate.
byChoice.zh: 正确。阿片类药物累积暴露及事件前给药时间，是需要沟通的重要治疗相关风险因素。

byChoice.en: Correct. Obesity is a clinically relevant risk factor for airway and ventilation problems, especially with OSA and opioids.
byChoice.zh: 正确。肥胖是气道和通气问题的重要风险因素，尤其合并OSA和阿片类药物时。

byChoice.en: Correct. Untreated OSA during sleep or sedation can worsen upper-airway obstruction when opioids reduce respiratory drive and tone.
byChoice.zh: 正确。睡眠或镇静时未处理的OSA会在阿片类药物降低呼吸驱动和肌张力时加重上气道阻塞。

byChoice.en: Correct. A safer plan addresses both pain and respiratory risk through reassessment, multimodal options when appropriate, and close monitoring.
byChoice.zh: 正确。更安全的计划应通过重新评估、适当的多模式选择和密切监测，同时处理疼痛和呼吸风险。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. These chronic medications do not explain the acute pattern of miosis, hypoventilation, and sedation after IV morphine.
byChoice.zh: 错误。这些长期用药不能解释静脉吗啡后出现的瞳孔缩小、通气不足和镇静急性模式。

byChoice.en: Incorrect. Pain must be treated, but restarting morphine before reassessment and revised orders would ignore the recent respiratory depression.
byChoice.zh: 错误。疼痛需要处理，但在重新评估和修订医嘱前恢复吗啡，会忽视刚发生的呼吸抑制。

testTakingStrategy.en: For adverse drug events, identify both modifiable factors and fixed risk factors. Prevention usually requires communication and a revised plan, not only treatment of the acute episode.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 对于药物不良事件，要同时识别可改变因素和固定风险因素。预防通常需要沟通并修订计划，而不仅是处理急性发作。

glossary.defZh: 睡眠时上气道反复部分或完全阻塞，导致低通气或呼吸暂停。
通过持续正压帮助保持上气道开放的治疗方法。
一段时间内多次给药相加形成的总药物暴露量。

correct.en: This case centers on recognizing and managing postoperative opioid-induced respiratory depression in a high-risk client. The key clinical judgment is to connect the timing after repeated IV morphine doses with new somnolence, shallow bradypnea, oxygen desaturation, and miosis, while noting that the dry dressing and stable drain output make bleeding less likely as the primary cause. Nursing priorities progress from stopping further opioid exposure and supporting airway/breathing, to escalating when stimulation and oxygen are insufficient, to anticipating protocol- or order-based titrated IV naloxone. After initial reversal, the client still requires close monitoring because opioid effects can recur as naloxone wanes, and the pain plan should be revised using safer multimodal strategies and OSA precautions such as CPAP during sleep when stable.
correct.zh: 本案例重点是识别并处理高风险患者术后阿片类药物相关呼吸抑制。关键临床判断是将多次静脉吗啡给药后的时间关系，与新发嗜睡、浅慢呼吸、血氧下降和瞳孔缩小联系起来，同时注意敷料干燥和引流量稳定，使出血作为主要原因的可能性较低。护理优先事项从停止进一步阿片暴露、支持气道和呼吸，发展到当刺激和给氧不足时升级处理，并预期按规程或医嘱小剂量滴定静脉纳洛酮。初步逆转后，患者仍需密切监测，因为纳洛酮作用减弱后阿片效应可能复发；镇痛方案应采用更安全的多模式策略，并在患者稳定后落实OSA相关措施，如睡眠时使用CPAP。

testTakingStrategy.en: In unfolding cases, track how the same problem evolves over time. A client who improves after naloxone is not automatically safe; compare drug durations, reassess trends, and prevent recurrence.
testTakingStrategy.zh: 在进展性案例中，要追踪同一问题如何随时间变化。纳洛酮后改善并不代表患者自动安全；要比较药物作用持续时间、重新评估趋势并预防复发。

glossary.termZh: 阿片类药物诱导的呼吸抑制
glossary.defZh: 阿片类药物抑制中枢呼吸驱动和/或加重气道问题，导致呼吸频率或深度下降。
阿片受体拮抗剂，用于逆转阿片类药物导致的镇静和呼吸抑制。
纳洛酮作用减弱后，残余阿片效应再次出现镇静或呼吸抑制。
联合不同机制的药物和非药物方法来控制疼痛并减少阿片类药物需求。
